description.zh: 将弱密钥与格式识别项迁入 JWT/哈希工具，Payload 仅保留可解释的令牌变体。
description.en: Move weak secrets and format-identification items into JWT or hash tools and retain only interpretable token variants as payloads.

review.rationale: 内容混合多个 JWT 缺陷和工具字典，无法用单一教程准确描述，必须拆分。

prerequisites.zh: 固定测试 issuer、audience、算法、kid 和低权限 claims，保存一枚有效 token 作为所有单变量实验的基线。
prerequisites.en: Pin the test issuer, audience, algorithm, kid, and low-privilege claims, retaining one valid token as the baseline for every single-variable experiment.

prerequisites.zh: 按解析、算法选择、密钥验证、claim 校验和资源授权分阶段执行，每次只改变算法、key 或一个 claim。
prerequisites.en: Execute parsing, algorithm selection, key validation, claim validation, and resource authorization in stages, changing only the algorithm, key, or one claim at a time.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须定位到具体阶段：无效签名被接受、错误 key 验证通过、受众/时效未校验，或篡改 claim 改变固定资源授权，并由服务端日志确认。token 能解码、错误码不同、某个弱词恰好是测试 secret、返回匿名 200、或一次综合样本失败都不能概括为 JWT 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence must identify a specific stage: an invalid signature accepted, a wrong key validated, audience or lifetime skipped, or a tampered claim changing authorization to the fixed resource, confirmed by server logs. Token decoding, different error codes, a weak word coincidentally used as a test secret, anonymous HTTP 200, or one mixed sample failing does not establish a JWT bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 任一单变量首次改变只读 canary 的认证或授权结果后停止，不继续叠加算法、密钥和 claim 变体。
opsecTips.en: Stop after any single variable first changes authentication or authorization for the read-only canary; do not stack algorithm, key, and claim variants.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试 token，轮换 fixture 密钥，清除 JWKS/认证缓存和阶段日志，并恢复完整验证策略。
opsecTips.en: Revoke test tokens, rotate fixture keys, clear JWKS and authentication caches and stage logs, and restore the complete validation policy.

name.zh: JWT 验证边界测试集

description.zh: 覆盖 none 算法、算法标识、常见签名密钥与声明变体，用于分阶段验证 JWT 解析、签名和授权边界。
description.en: Covers none algorithms, algorithm identifiers, common signing secrets, and claim variants for staged review of JWT parsing, signature, and authorization boundaries.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 验证边界的综合测试场景，检验解析、签名与授权三层的组合缺陷。验证维度为 none 令牌、算法头变体、常见弱密钥与声明篡改的分阶段对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers comprehensive JWT validation-boundary testing, testing combined flaws across parsing, signature and authorization layers. Validation phases through none tokens, algorithm-header variants, common weak keys and claim tampering, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 JWT 处理链对算法、密钥强度与声明校验各自松散：none 绕过、弱密钥离线破译或声明篡改任一路径成立即可伪造身份令牌。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is loose handling of algorithm, key strength and claim checks across the JWT chain: any successful path among none bypass, weak-key offline cracking or claim tampering forges identity tokens.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本先提交 none 与变体算法令牌确认算法固定，再用常见弱密钥对截获令牌离线验签尝试，最后篡改声明以已知密钥重签提交：任一路径接受伪造令牌即确认对应层缺陷。成功判据以伪造令牌的授权效果为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用合成身份。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit none and variant-algorithm tokens to confirm algorithm pinning per the script, then attempt offline verification of captured tokens against common weak keys, and finally tamper claims and re-sign with a known key before submitting; acceptance along any path confirms the corresponding layer defect. Judge success by forged tokens' authorization effects. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; synthetic identities throughout.

mitigation.zh: 统一 JWT 安全基线：算法白名单、密钥强度审计、验签前不采信声明。修复后重放第 1 步三条路径，全部伪造令牌应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Adopt a unified JWT baseline: algorithm allowlists, key-strength audits, and no claim trust before verification. After the fix, replay all three step 1 paths: every forged token should be rejected with alerts.

description.zh: 分别记录合法令牌的解析、签名、主体与授权结果。
description.en: Record parsing, signature, principal, and authorization results separately for a valid token.

title.en: Apply candidates one variable at a time

description.zh: 按算法、密钥和声明拆分原始集合，禁止同时更改多层。
description.en: Split the original set by algorithm, secret, and claim and never alter several layers at once.

description.zh: 将实际受保护访问与验证日志关联，确定问题发生在签名还是授权层。
description.en: Correlate protected access with validation logs to locate the failure in signature or authorization handling.

review.rationale: 这是可拆分执行的 JWT 综合测试集合，应归 JWT 安全并明确分层证据。

title.zh: 头部变形：重复键 alg 覆盖
title.en: Header Mutation: Duplicate alg Key Override

description.zh: 头部写两个 alg 键（RS256 在前 none 在后），不同 JSON 解析器取值不同，绕过头部静态校验；成功判据：任一解析路径按 none 接受。
description.en: Two alg keys make parsers disagree (first vs last), bypassing static header validation. Success: some parse path accepts it as none.

title.zh: 头部变形：base64 填充差异

description.zh: 各段保留 = 填充（非规范 base64url），改变整串特征并测试实现的宽容解码；成功判据：带填充令牌仍通过验证。
description.en: Keeps = padding on segments (non-canonical base64url) to alter the signature and probe lenient decoding. Success: the padded token still validates.

description.zh: typ/alg 键序交换且 alg 大小写变形，规避固定键序 base64 特征（eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlw 前缀）；成功判据：令牌按 none 语义接受。
description.en: Swaps key order and mutates alg case to evade the fixed-order eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlw prefix signature. Success: the token is accepted with none semantics.

title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT Validation Boundary Test Set

description.zh: 把 none 算法令牌与弱密钥逐条对照测试；任一路径接受伪造令牌，即确认 JWT 验证边界缺陷。
description.en: Test the none-algorithm tokens and weak secrets as controls; any path accepting a forged token confirms JWT validation-boundary flaws.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用 OAuth 测试客户端、合成用户和已登记的精确回调 URI，控制所有候选域和中间重定向。
prerequisites.en: Use a dedicated OAuth test client, synthetic user, and exactly registered callback URI, controlling every candidate domain and intermediate redirect.

prerequisites.zh: 在授权请求和 token 兑换阶段记录 client_id、redirect_uri、code、state 与浏览器最终导航，使用一次性 code canary。
prerequisites.en: Record client_id, redirect_uri, code, state, and final browser navigation at authorization and token-exchange stages, using a one-time code canary.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求未登记或解析歧义的回调实际收到为测试客户端签发的授权码/令牌，并且该 code 能在预期绑定条件下兑换或被外部方利用；开放重定向链也需证明凭据离开登记源。仅跳转到错误页、外域收到无 code 请求、授权服务器返回错误、浏览器地址栏显示候选 URI 或 code 无法兑换都不是可利用 redirect_uri 缺陷。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an unregistered or ambiguously parsed callback to actually receive a code or token issued for the test client, with that code redeemable under the affected binding or usable by the external party; an open-redirect chain must also show the credential leaving the registered origin. Redirecting to an error page, an external domain receiving no code, authorization-server rejection, a candidate URI appearing in the address bar, or an unredeemable code is not an exploitable redirect_uri flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 一个一次性 code 首次到达受控未登记回调后停止，不兑换真实账户 code 或扩展到其他客户端。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one one-time code reaches the controlled unregistered callback; do not redeem codes for real accounts or expand to other clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code 和测试会话，删除外部回调日志与 DNS/页面，清理浏览器数据，并恢复 URI 精确匹配和兑换绑定。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the code and test session, delete external callback logs and DNS or page data, clear browser data, and restore exact URI matching and exchange binding.

name.zh: OAuth redirect_uri 恶意回调变体

description.zh: 验证授权服务器是否对预注册重定向 URI 执行精确匹配，阻止外部域、解析歧义和开放重定向链窃取授权响应。
description.en: Tests whether an authorization server exactly matches registered redirect URIs and blocks external hosts, parsing ambiguities, and open-redirect chains from receiving authorization responses.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth redirect_uri 严格匹配场景，检验授权服务器对未注册回调变体的拒绝边界。验证维度为路径后缀、查询占位与编码变体的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth redirect_uri strict matching, testing rejection boundaries for unregistered callback variants at the authorization server. Validation is a single-step matrix of path suffixes, query placeholders and encoding variants, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权服务器匹配回调时忽略路径或查询差异：未注册变体仍被接受签发 code，授权响应可被引导至攻击者可控地址并被完整窃取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the authorization server ignoring path or query differences when matching callbacks: unregistered variants still receive codes, steering authorization responses to attacker-controlled addresses for full theft.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把未注册回调的路径、查询、片段与编码变体逐条提交授权端点，记录是否签发 code 或执行跳转：任一变体仍完成签发即确认绑定不严格。成功判据以授权服务器的错误码与重定向行为为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；先以合法回调标定基线。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit unregistered-callback path, query, fragment and encoding variants to the authorization endpoint one by one per the script, recording whether codes are issued or redirects executed; any variant completing issuance confirms loose binding. Judge success by authorization-server error codes and redirect behavior. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; baseline with the legitimate callback first.

mitigation.zh: redirect_uri 执行注册值完整比对并禁止通配与忽略子路径，开放重定向页面不得位于回调域。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应返回 invalid_request。
mitigation.en: Compare redirect_uri fully against registered values, banning wildcards and subpath ignoring, with no open-redirect pages under callback domains. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should return invalid_request.

description.zh: 使用注册回调记录授权码、state、PKCE 和最终 Location。
description.en: Use the registered callback and record code, state, PKCE, and final Location.

description.zh: 依次提交原始 redirect_uri 变体，保持客户端和用户会话不变。
description.en: Submit the original redirect_uri variants while preserving client and user session.

review.rationale: 属于 OAuth 回调绑定与认证流程安全，保留在认证并补充 code 可兑换证据。

description.en: Bypasses single-slash allowlist matching since tolerant parsers accept extra slashes. Success: the code is issued to the attacker host.

description.en: Encoded #/? suffixes strip at normalization, splitting allowlist comparison from the actual redirect. Success: comparison passes and the redirect hits the attacker host.

prerequisites.zh: 为两个 OAuth 测试客户端、两个浏览器会话和合成用户签发可追踪的一次性授权码，记录过期时间和 PKCE 状态。
prerequisites.en: Issue traceable one-time authorization codes for two OAuth test clients, two browser sessions, and a synthetic user, recording expiry and PKCE state.

prerequisites.zh: 分别设计重放、过期、错误 client、错误 redirect_uri 和错误 verifier 对照，所有兑换只指向无敏感 token canary。
prerequisites.en: Design separate replay, expired, wrong-client, wrong-redirect_uri, and wrong-verifier controls, with every exchange returning only a nonsensitive token canary.

analysis.zh: 阳性是同一授权码被成功兑换两次，或在错误客户端、回调、会话/PKCE 绑定下仍签发可用于固定资源的 token，授权服务器日志可关联该 code。字符串 `STOLEN_CODE` 被接收、错误信息不同、第一次合法兑换、空值触发 500、或返回无法使用的 token 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the same authorization code being redeemed twice, or a usable token for the fixed resource being issued under the wrong client, callback, session, or PKCE binding, correlated in authorization-server logs. Acceptance of the literal STOLEN_CODE, different error messages, the first legitimate exchange, an empty value causing HTTP 500, or an unusable token is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一次异常兑换成功并验证无敏感 canary 后停止，不把 token 用于其他资源或继续重放。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one anomalous exchange succeeds and the nonsensitive canary is verified; do not use the token on other resources or replay it again.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有 code、token 和浏览器会话，删除客户端 fixture 与交换日志，并恢复单次消费、短时效和完整绑定。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all codes, tokens, and browser sessions, delete client fixtures and exchange logs, and restore single use, short lifetime, and complete binding.

name.zh: OAuth 授权码重放与绑定测试
name.en: OAuth Authorization-Code Replay and Binding Test

description.zh: 验证授权码是否短时、单次使用，并与客户端、重定向 URI 和 PKCE verifier 绑定。
description.en: Tests whether authorization codes are short-lived, single-use, and bound to the client, redirect URI, and PKCE verifier.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 授权码重放与绑定场景，检验 code 的时效、单次性与多要素绑定。验证维度为窃取、过期、重放与异常值 code 的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth authorization-code replay and binding, testing code freshness, single-use and multi-factor binding. Validation is a single-step matrix of stolen, expired, replayed and anomalous codes, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权码消费未与客户端、redirect_uri 及 PKCE 绑定或未即时失效：被截获的 code 在有效窗口内可由任意客户端重复兑换。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is code consumption unbound to client, redirect_uri and PKCE or not invalidated promptly: intercepted codes can be redeemed repeatedly by any client within their validity window.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把窃取、过期、重放与空值 code 逐条提交令牌端点，记录兑换结果：任一非本轮 code 仍换取令牌即确认绑定或失效缺失，同时核对兑换请求中的客户端凭据是否被校验。成功判据以令牌端点响应矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit stolen, expired, replayed and empty codes to the token endpoint one by one per the script, recording redemption outcomes; any non-current code still exchanging for tokens confirms missing binding or invalidation, also checking whether client credentials in redemption requests are verified. Judge success by the token-endpoint response matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 授权码签发即绑定客户端与回调值，兑换成功或失败均立即烧毁并叠加 PKCE 强制。修复后重放第 1 步，全部异常 code 应返回 invalid_grant。
mitigation.en: Bind codes to client and callback values at issuance, burn them immediately on success or failure, and enforce PKCE on top. After the fix, replay step 1: every anomalous code should return invalid_grant.

description.zh: 记录未兑换 code 的客户端、回调、PKCE 和签发时间。
description.en: Record client, redirect, PKCE, and issue time for an unredeemed code.

description.zh: 先正常兑换，再使用原始 code 变体重复请求令牌。

description.en: Submit stolen, expired, and replayed codes to the token endpoint; any out-of-band code redeeming successfully confirms missing authorization-code binding.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个隔离浏览器配置文件和合成 OAuth 账户，记录每次授权启动时生成的 state、会话 Cookie 和回调消费事件。
prerequisites.en: Use two isolated browser profiles and synthetic OAuth accounts, recording generated state, session cookie, and callback consumption for every authorization start.

prerequisites.zh: 准备缺失、固定、可预测、跨会话、已消费和错误 state 对照，并确保授权码本身只对测试客户端有效。
prerequisites.en: Prepare missing, fixed, predictable, cross-session, already-consumed, and wrong-state controls, ensuring the authorization code is valid only for the test client.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求错误、缺失或来自另一浏览器会话的 state 回调被接受，并让当前合成浏览器绑定到攻击者选择的测试身份或消费响应。回调页面返回 200、state 参数存在、随机值长度较长、授权服务器先前登录、错误回调被记录但未建立会话都不是 OAuth 登录 CSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a callback with missing, incorrect, or another browser session's state to be accepted and bind the current synthetic browser to an attacker-selected test identity or consume the response. HTTP 200 on the callback page, state merely being present, a long random-looking value, a prior authorization-server login, or logging a bad callback without creating a session is not OAuth login CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 一个跨会话 state 首次改变合成登录身份后停止，不继续触发账户绑定、资料修改或真实用户登录。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one cross-session state first changes the synthetic logged-in identity; do not continue to account linking, profile changes, or real-user login.

opsecTips.zh: 注销两套浏览器会话，撤销 code/token，清除回调与 state 存储，并恢复随机生成、会话绑定和单次消费。
opsecTips.en: Revoke both browser sessions and all codes or tokens, clear callback and state storage, and restore random generation, session binding, and single consumption.

name.zh: OAuth state 缺失与固定值测试
name.en: OAuth state Missing and Fixed-Value Test

description.zh: 验证 OAuth state 的不可预测性、会话绑定与一次性消费，覆盖缺失、空值、固定值、注入与类型混淆变体。
description.en: Verify OAuth state unpredictability, session binding, and one-time consumption, covering missing, empty, fixed, injected, and type-confusion variants.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth state 绑定与随机性场景，检验客户端对缺失、固定与可预测 state 的处理边界。验证维度为空值、字面量与可预测值的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth state binding and randomness, testing client handling of missing, fixed and predictable state values. Validation is a single-step matrix of empty, literal and predictable values, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 state 未按会话存储或校验可被绕过：跨站页面携带伪造 state 完成回调即把攻击者账号绑定到受害者会话，形成登录 CSRF。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is state not stored per session or checks being bypassable: cross-site pages complete callbacks with forged state, binding attacker accounts into victim sessions as login CSRF.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把缺失、空值、固定与可预测 state 逐条注入 OAuth 回调流程，记录登录是否完成及账号绑定对象：服务端不校验 state 仍建立会话即确认登录 CSRF，以会话建立与 state 消费记录为成功判据，并用会话快照留证；回调被拒绝且无会话建立则说明防护有效。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject missing, empty, fixed and predictable state values into the OAuth callback flow one by one per the script, recording whether logins complete and which accounts bind; the server establishing sessions without state validation confirms login CSRF, evidenced by session snapshots. Judge success by callback-rejection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: state 由 CSPRNG 生成并与发起会话绑定存储，回调时严格比对并一次性消费。修复后重放第 1 步，全部异常 state 应被拒绝且无账号绑定发生。
mitigation.en: Generate state with a CSPRNG bound to the initiating session, compare strictly on callback and consume once. After the fix, replay step 1: every anomalous state should be rejected with no account binding.

description.zh: 在两个隔离浏览器会话发起授权并保存各自 state 与账号。
description.en: Start authorization in two isolated browser sessions and save each state and account.

description.en: Verify the server principal and state-consumption record after callback, excluding a simple login-page response.

review.rationale: state 缺陷属于 OAuth 登录 CSRF，分类从泛认证细化到 CSRF。

description.en: Divergent picks between front and backend on repeated params. Success: flow completes with the attacker state.

description.zh: 超长值使校验层截断比较通过。判据：流程推进到回调。
description.en: Truncation at the validation layer lets the check pass. Success: flow reaches the callback.

description.en: Submit URL, script, and type-confused state values through the OAuth flow; state treated as a redirect or injection sink confirms state-handling flaws.

prerequisites.zh: 为两个资源服务器和至少两个 scope 签发有效签名的合成 access token，固定 issuer、subject、token type 与时效。
prerequisites.en: Issue validly signed synthetic access tokens for two resource servers and at least two scopes, pinning issuer, subject, token type, and lifetime.

prerequisites.zh: 准备错误 aud、低 scope、ID token 冒充 access token 及客户端参数伪造 scope 的对照，并记录资源端授权决策。
prerequisites.en: Prepare wrong-audience, low-scope, ID-token-as-access-token, and client-parameter scope-forgery controls, recording resource-server authorization decisions.

analysis.zh: 阳性是签名有效但 aud 指向另一服务、scope 不足或 token type 错误的 token 仍访问了固定受保护动作，资源端日志显示约束未执行。仅在请求参数中写 admin、解码 claims 看到目标词、授权服务器拒绝、返回公开数据、或原 token 本就含所需 scope 都不是 audience/scope 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a validly signed token with another service's audience, insufficient scope, or wrong token type still reaching the fixed protected action, with resource-server logs showing the constraint was skipped. Writing admin in a request parameter, decoding a target word from claims, authorization-server rejection, receiving public data, or a token already containing the required scope is not audience or scope bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 错误 aud 或低 scope token 首次到达无副作用 canary 后停止，不调用写操作或跨资源服务器扩展。
opsecTips.en: Stop after a wrong-audience or low-scope token first reaches the side-effect-free canary; do not invoke writes or expand across resource servers.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试 token 和客户端授权，清理资源端缓存与审计记录，并恢复 aud、scope、typ 和 issuer 的独立校验。
opsecTips.en: Revoke test tokens and client grants, clear resource-server caches and audit records, and restore independent aud, scope, typ, and issuer validation.

name.zh: Token audience 与 scope 约束测试
name.en: Token Audience and Scope Constraint Test

description.zh: 验证资源服务器是否强制校验 aud、scope 和 token 类型，防止把为其他服务或较低权限签发的 token 当作高权限凭据。
description.en: Tests whether resource servers enforce audience, scope, and token type so that tokens issued for another service or lower privilege are not accepted as elevated credentials.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖令牌 audience 与 scope 约束场景，检验资源服务器是否校验令牌用途与权限范围。验证维度为 aud 值替换与 scope 提升的令牌请求矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers token audience and scope constraints, testing whether resource servers validate token purpose and privilege range. Validation is a request matrix of aud swaps and scope elevation, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于资源服务器只验签名不验 aud 与 scope：为其他服务或低权用途签发的令牌被当作高权凭据使用，跨服务权限边界失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is resource servers verifying signatures but not aud and scope: tokens issued for other services or low-privilege purposes work as high-privilege credentials, voiding cross-service boundaries.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本以低权测试令牌为基础构造 aud 为管理服务与 scope 提升的请求变体逐条提交目标 API，记录放行结果：超范围令牌访问成功即确认约束缺失。成功判据以越权访问记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时验证令牌类型字段是否被检查。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build request variants per the script on a low-privilege test token with aud set to management services and elevated scopes, submitting each to the target API and recording allowances; over-scoped tokens succeeding confirms missing constraints. Judge success by unauthorized-access records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; also verify whether token-type fields are checked.

mitigation.zh: 资源服务器强制校验 aud 匹配本服务与 scope 覆盖所需权限，令牌类型按用途区分。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部越权请求应返回 403。
mitigation.en: Resource servers must enforce aud matching their service and scope coverage of required permissions, distinguishing token types per purpose. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every over-scope request should get 403.

description.zh: 记录不同 audience/scope 测试令牌在各资源服务器上的预期权限。
description.en: Record expected permissions for test tokens with different audiences and scopes on each resource server.

description.zh: 使用原始 aud/scope 变体访问另一资源，保持签名与用户不变。
description.en: Use the original aud and scope variants against another resource while preserving signature and user.

description.zh: 从资源服务器日志和受保护响应确认是否执行了 audience 与 scope 约束。
description.en: Use resource-server logs and protected responses to confirm audience and scope enforcement.

review.rationale: 内容是签名令牌的 audience/scope 授权约束，应归 JWT 安全。

description.en: Omitting aud skips audience validation while wildcard scopes exploit lenient authorization matching. Success: wildcard scopes are honored.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Token Audience and Scope Constraint Test

description.zh: 把 aud/scope 提升值逐条置于令牌与请求；服务端按提升值放行越权访问，即确认受众与范围约束缺失。
description.en: Place each aud or scope escalation into tokens and requests; the server granting access per the escalated values confirms missing audience and scope constraints.

prerequisites.zh: 使用公共 OAuth 测试客户端生成高熵 verifier 与对应 S256 challenge，记录授权码、方法和客户端实例绑定。
prerequisites.en: Use a public OAuth test client to generate a high-entropy verifier and matching S256 challenge, recording code, method, and client-instance binding.

prerequisites.zh: 分别测试缺失、空值、错误 verifier、错误 challenge、降级 plain 和跨实例 verifier，且每个 code 只尝试一次主对照。
prerequisites.en: Test missing, empty, wrong verifier, wrong challenge, plain downgrade, and cross-instance verifier separately, with one primary control attempt per code.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求授权码在缺失或不匹配 verifier、错误方法或另一客户端实例下仍兑换出可用于固定资源的 token，服务器记录显示 PKCE 未绑定。参数被解析、token 端点返回不同错误、合法 verifier 成功、code 已先消费、或返回不可用 token 都不构成 PKCE 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an authorization code to yield a usable token for the fixed resource despite a missing or mismatched verifier, wrong method, or another client instance, with server records showing PKCE was not bound. Parsed parameters, different token-endpoint errors, success with the legitimate verifier, a code already consumed, or an unusable token does not establish PKCE bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个不匹配 verifier 首次兑换成功后停止，不对同一 code 继续猜测或测试真实移动/桌面客户端。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one mismatched verifier first redeems successfully; do not continue guessing that code or test real mobile or desktop clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code/token，删除 verifier/challenge fixture 和客户端日志，并恢复 S256 强制、长度校验与实例绑定。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes and tokens, delete verifier and challenge fixtures and client logs, and restore mandatory S256, length validation, and instance binding.

name.zh: PKCE verifier 绑定测试

description.zh: 验证授权服务器是否要求有效 code_challenge，并在令牌交换时精确校验对应 code_verifier 与方法。
description.en: Tests whether the authorization server requires a valid code_challenge and exactly verifies the corresponding code_verifier and method during token exchange.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 PKCE verifier 绑定场景，检验授权服务器对 challenge 与 verifier 对应关系的强制程度。验证维度为空值、伪造 verifier 与缺失方法的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers PKCE verifier binding, testing how strictly the authorization server enforces challenge-verifier correspondence. Validation is a single-step matrix of empty, forged verifiers and missing methods, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 PKCE 未被强制或 verifier 校验可跳过：拦截授权请求的攻击者以自有 verifier 或空值完成令牌交换，授权码保护被架空。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is PKCE not being mandatory or verifier checks being skippable: attackers intercepting authorization requests complete token exchange with their own or empty verifiers, voiding code protection.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本以空 verifier、伪造值与缺失 challenge_method 组合逐条提交令牌交换请求，记录兑换结果：任一组合仍换取令牌即确认 PKCE 绑定未强制。成功判据以令牌端点响应矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；先以合法 verifier 对确认基线可用。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit token-exchange requests combining empty verifiers, forged values and missing challenge_method one by one per the script, recording redemption outcomes; any combination still exchanging tokens confirms PKCE binding is not enforced. Judge success by the token-endpoint response matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; confirm baseline viability with a legitimate verifier pair first.

mitigation.zh: 公共客户端强制 PKCE 且服务端校验 S256 方法与 verifier 匹配，缺失或不匹配一律拒绝交换。修复后重放第 1 步，全部异常组合应返回 invalid_grant。
mitigation.en: Mandate PKCE for public clients with server-side S256 method and verifier matching, rejecting exchanges on absence or mismatch. After the fix, replay step 1: every anomalous combination should return invalid_grant.

description.zh: 保存正常授权的 challenge、code、verifier 与客户端绑定。
description.en: Save challenge, code, verifier, and client binding from a normal authorization.

description.zh: 在授权和令牌阶段分别使用原始空值及固定值变体。
description.en: Use the original empty and fixed-value variants separately at authorization and token stages.

description.zh: 核对 token 响应和服务端绑定日志，确认错误 verifier 无法获取 token。
description.en: Check token response and server binding logs to confirm a wrong verifier cannot obtain a token.

review.rationale: 属于 OAuth 客户端授权码绑定控制，保留为认证 Payload。

description.zh: 省略 S256 强制校验时 plain 方法允许明文 challenge 伪造。成功判据：verifier 不匹配仍换到令牌。
description.en: When S256 enforcement is missing, the plain method allows forging the challenge. Success: tokens are issued despite a verifier mismatch.

description.zh: 空白/null 形态绕过必填与比对。成功判据：空 verifier 通过校验。
description.en: Whitespace/null forms bypass required-field checks and comparison. Success: an empty verifier validates.

description.zh: 注册与验证阶段取不同 challenge 实例实现错配。成功判据：错配组合完成令牌交换。
description.en: Registration and validation read different challenge instances allowing mismatch. Success: the mismatched pair completes token exchange.

title.en: Validation step 1 for PKCE Verifier Binding Test

description.zh: 把空或伪造 code_verifier 与 challenge 逐条提交令牌端点；交换仍成功即确认 PKCE 绑定未强制。
description.en: Submit empty or forged code_verifier and challenge values to the token endpoint; a successful exchange confirms unenforced PKCE binding.

prerequisites.zh: 建立专用 IdP/SP 测试租户、合成主体和唯一 Assertion/Response ID，固定证书、Audience、Recipient 与时钟。
prerequisites.en: Create dedicated IdP and SP test tenants, a synthetic principal, and unique Assertion and Response IDs, pinning certificate, Audience, Recipient, and clock.

prerequisites.zh: 保留一份有效签名基线，每次只改变签名引用、Assertion 位置、NameID、算法、时效或重放状态，并采集解析树与消费节点。
prerequisites.en: Retain one validly signed baseline, changing only signature reference, Assertion position, NameID, algorithm, lifetime, or replay state per test while collecting the parsed tree and consumed node.

analysis.zh: 阳性是 SP 消费了未被所验证签名覆盖的恶意 Assertion，或在错误 Audience/Recipient、过期、弱算法或重放条件下建立了合成管理员会话，日志能对应实际消费节点。XML 可解析、文档中存在有效 Signature、NameID 文本为 admin、返回 SAML 错误或只验证 Response 而未创建会话都不是成功绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the SP consuming a malicious Assertion not covered by the validated signature, or creating a synthetic administrator session despite wrong Audience or Recipient, expiry, weak algorithm, or replay, with logs identifying the consumed node. Parsable XML, a valid Signature somewhere in the document, admin text in NameID, a SAML error, or Response-only validation without session creation is not a successful bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个异常 Assertion 首次建立只读测试会话后停止，不访问真实联合用户、属性或下游服务。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one abnormal Assertion first creates a read-only test session; do not access real federated users, attributes, or downstream services.

opsecTips.zh: 注销 SP/IdP 会话，撤销 Assertion ID，删除测试证书和 XML fixture，清除元数据缓存并恢复节点级签名校验。
opsecTips.en: Revoke SP and IdP sessions and Assertion IDs, delete test certificates and XML fixtures, clear metadata caches, and restore node-level signature validation.

name.zh: SAML 断言片段篡改样例集

description.zh: 验证服务提供方是否校验实际使用的 Assertion 签名、Audience、Recipient、时效与防重放属性，覆盖 XML 签名包装和弱算法边界。
description.en: Tests whether a service provider validates the signature on the assertion it consumes plus Audience, Recipient, time constraints, and replay protections, including XML signature wrapping and weak-algorithm boundaries.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML 断言与 XML 签名验证场景，检验服务提供方对签名包装、受众与时效属性的处理。验证维度为注释混淆、重复 ID 与声明重写的变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAML assertion and XML signature validation, testing service-provider handling of signature wrappers, audience and freshness attributes. Validation is a variant matrix of comment confusion, duplicate IDs and claim rewrites, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证与消费的断言对象可能不一致：签名包装让合法签名覆盖恶意声明，注释混淆与重复 ID 进一步扰乱解析器选择，身份可被替换。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is potential mismatch between verified and consumed assertions: signature wrappers let valid signatures cover malicious claims, while comment confusion and duplicate IDs further confuse parser selection, enabling identity swaps.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本构造注释包裹的 NameID、重复 ID 断言与受众重写等变体逐条提交 ACS，记录身份解析与验证结果：篡改后的 NameID 或 Audience 被采信即确认断言验证缺陷。成功判据以登录身份与验证日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅使用测试 IdP 签名夹具。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build variants such as comment-wrapped NameIDs, duplicate-ID assertions and rewritten audiences per the script and submit each to the ACS, recording identity resolution and verification outcomes; tampered NameIDs or audiences being trusted confirms the assertion-validation flaw. Judge success by login identity and verification logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only test-IdP signature fixtures.

mitigation.zh: 验证器只消费签名引用的断言并拒绝重复 ID 与注释混淆，Audience、Recipient 与 NotOnOrAfter 全部强制校验。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应被拒绝并记录告警。
mitigation.en: Verifiers must consume only signature-referenced assertions, rejecting duplicate IDs and comment confusion, with Audience, Recipient and NotOnOrAfter fully enforced. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should be rejected with alerts.

description.zh: 记录签名引用到的 Assertion、ID、Audience、Recipient 和时效。
description.en: Record the referenced Assertion, ID, Audience, Recipient, and time constraints.

title.zh: 构造单一 XML 变体

description.zh: 利用原始 XML 片段每次只改变节点位置、ID、NameID 或算法。
description.en: Use the original XML fragments to change only node placement, ID, NameID, or algorithm per test.

title.zh: 验证 SP 最终主体

description.zh: 将签名验证日志与实际登录主体关联，排除仅解析成功。
description.en: Correlate signature-validation logs with the actual signed-in principal, excluding parse-only success.

review.rationale: 属于 SAML 身份断言验证缺陷，保留为认证 Payload 并补充签名节点与主体证据。

description.zh: HTML 实体编码绕过 NameID 内容比对与 WAF 特征。成功判据：解码后命中 admin 账户。
description.en: HTML entity encoding bypasses NameID comparison and WAF signatures. Success: decodes to the admin account.

description.en: Comments inside the tag bypass structure-based filters while some parsers still resolve it. Success: the NameID value takes effect after parsing.

description.zh: 前插未签名断言，验证器取签名断言而应用取首个。成功判据：以 admin 身份登录。
description.en: Prepending an unsigned assertion while the validator reads the signed one and the app reads the first. Success: logged in as admin.

prerequisites.zh: 使用已登记的 OAuth 测试客户端和合成用户，绘制 authorization、token 与 resource 端点各自允许的参数和 grant。
prerequisites.en: Use a registered OAuth test client and synthetic user, mapping allowed parameters and grants separately for authorization, token, and resource endpoints.

prerequisites.zh: 固定客户端类型、回调、scope 和 issuer，每次只改变 response_type、grant_type、client_id、redirect_uri 或 scope 中的一项。
prerequisites.en: Pin client type, callback, scope, and issuer, changing only one of response_type, grant_type, client_id, redirect_uri, or scope per test.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须落到具体策略：未登记 response/grant 获得可用 token、错误客户端或回调收到 code、或未授予 scope 被资源端接受，并由各端点日志形成链路。参数被接受进入错误页、协议返回标准错误、前端显示 scope、token 无法用于资源、或把所有候选拼在一条请求中都不是 OAuth 流程绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence must map to a specific policy: an unregistered response or grant yielding a usable token, the wrong client or callback receiving a code, or ungranted scope accepted by the resource server, linked through endpoint logs. Parameters reaching an error page, a standard protocol error, scope shown by the client, a token unusable at the resource, or combining all candidates in one request is not an OAuth flow bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 任一单参数首次违反注册策略并到达无副作用 canary 后停止，不叠加其他 OAuth 参数。
opsecTips.en: Stop after any single parameter first violates registration policy and reaches the side-effect-free canary; do not stack other OAuth parameters.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、token、grant 和测试会话，删除客户端 fixture 与端点调试日志，并恢复注册元数据约束。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, tokens, grants, and test sessions, delete client fixtures and endpoint debug logs, and restore registration-metadata constraints.

name.zh: OAuth 参数与流程约束测试
name.en: OAuth Parameter and Flow Constraint Test

description.zh: 分阶段验证 response_type、grant_type、client_id、redirect_uri 与 scope 是否符合客户端注册信息和授权服务器策略。
description.en: Tests in stages whether response_type, grant_type, client_id, redirect_uri, and scope conform to client registration and authorization-server policy.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 参数与流程约束场景，检验授权与令牌端点对 response_type、grant_type 等参数的策略一致性。验证维度为响应类型混合、客户端伪造与流程切换变体的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth parameter and flow constraints, testing policy consistency across authorization and token endpoints for response_type, grant_type and peers. Validation is a single-step matrix of mixed response types, client forgery and flow-switching variants, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于端点对参数组合缺少注册策略约束：response_type 混用、grant_type 越权切换或 client_id 伪造未被拒绝时，授权流程被诱导进入非预期分支。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is endpoints lacking registered policy constraints on parameter combinations: mixed response_types, unauthorized grant_type switches or forged client_ids go unrefused, steering flows into unintended branches.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把 response_type 混合值、未注册 client_id 与 grant_type 切换等变体逐条加入授权与令牌请求，记录流程行为差异：出现跳过同意、隐式令牌直发或错误流程即确认约束缺失。成功判据以端点行为矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, add variants such as mixed response_type values, unregistered client_ids and grant_type switches to authorization and token requests one by one per the script, recording behavioral differences; consent skips, implicit tokens issued directly or wrong flows confirm missing constraints. Judge success by the endpoint-behavior matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按客户端注册固化允许的 response_type 与 grant_type 组合，未知参数拒绝并审计异常流程请求。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应返回 invalid_request 或被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Fix allowed response_type and grant_type combinations per client registration, rejecting unknown parameters and auditing anomalous flow requests. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should return invalid_request or be denied.

description.zh: 记录测试客户端允许的流程、回调和 scope，建立预期矩阵。
description.en: Record allowed flows, callbacks, and scopes for the test client and build an expectation matrix.

description.zh: 将原始参数分到授权或令牌端点，每次只改变一个注册约束。
description.en: Route the original parameters to authorization or token endpoints and change one registration constraint at a time.

description.en: Add each OAuth parameter variant to authorization and token requests; flow behavior changing per injected parameter (consent skipped, grant type switched) confirms missing flow constraints.

prerequisites.zh: 创建数量相等的存在与不存在合成用户名，并确保它们在登录、注册和找回流程中没有真实邮件或短信副作用。
prerequisites.en: Create equal-sized sets of existing and nonexistent synthetic usernames, ensuring login, registration, and recovery flows cause no real email or SMS side effects.

prerequisites.zh: 固定网络、请求体、验证码和速率，以随机顺序重复采集状态、正文结构、Header、时延和异步通知事件。
prerequisites.en: Fix network, request body, CAPTCHA, and rate, then repeatedly collect status, body structure, headers, latency, and asynchronous notification events in randomized order.

analysis.zh: 阳性是存在与不存在账户在重复样本中表现出稳定、可分类的响应或时序差异，或异步通道只为存在账户产生事件，且显著优于随机基线。字典中含 admin、一次响应不同、限流阈值、邮件服务抖动、缓存冷热或合法用户输入校验差异均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a stable, classifiable response or timing difference between existing and nonexistent synthetic accounts across repeated samples, or an asynchronous event emitted only for existing accounts, significantly outperforming random baseline. The word admin in the dictionary, one differing response, rate-limit thresholds, mail-service jitter, warm versus cold caches, or legitimate input-validation differences are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 达到预设统计置信度或确认一个明确差异后停止，不扩大用户名列表或触发账户锁定。
opsecTips.en: Stop after reaching the predefined statistical confidence or confirming one explicit differential; do not expand the username list or trigger account lockout.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成账户和通知队列，清除采样日志与缓存标记，解除测试限流状态并恢复统一响应。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic accounts and notification queues, clear sample logs and cache markers, release test rate-limit state, and restore uniform responses.

name.zh: 常见用户名枚举字典

description.zh: 面向授权测试账号的常见用户名候选集合，用于检查登录、找回密码和注册接口是否泄露账号存在性。
description.en: A common-username candidate set for authorized test accounts, used to check whether login, recovery, and registration endpoints disclose account existence.

subCategory.zh: 凭证注入与弱类型登录绕过

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖常见用户名枚举场景，检验注册、登录与重置入口对账号存在性的信息泄露差异。验证维度为常见用户名清单在三类入口的差异化提交与响应比对，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers common username enumeration, testing information-disclosure differences on account existence across registration, login and reset entries. Validation submits a common-username list differentially across the three entries with response comparison, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于接口对存在与不存在账号返回不同提示、耗时或流程分支：攻击者据此批量确认有效用户名，为口令喷洒与定向钓鱼提供目标清单。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is interfaces returning different messages, latencies or flow branches for existing versus absent accounts: attackers bulk-confirm valid usernames, feeding password spraying and targeted phishing lists.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把清单中的常见用户名逐条提交注册、登录与重置入口，记录响应文案、状态码与耗时差异：已存在提示或可测量的时间差即确认枚举面，绘制差异矩阵作为证据。成功判据以响应差异的可区分性为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；请求频率控制在授权阈值内。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit common usernames from the list to registration, login and reset entries one by one, recording message, status and latency differences; existing-user notices or measurable timing deltas confirm the enumeration surface, charted into a differential matrix as evidence. Judge success by distinguishability of response differences. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; keep request rates within authorized thresholds.

mitigation.zh: 三类入口返回统一提示与常量耗时，注册流程延迟到邮件确认阶段暴露结果。修复后重放第 1 步，存在与不存在账号的响应应不可区分。
mitigation.en: Return uniform messages and constant latencies across the three entries, deferring registration outcomes to the email-confirmation stage. After the fix, replay step 1: responses for existing and absent accounts should be indistinguishable.

description.zh: 用已知存在和随机不存在的测试账号重复采样响应。
description.en: Repeatedly sample responses for known existing and random nonexistent test accounts.

title.en: Submit candidates at a low rate

description.zh: 按原始用户名集合测试，保留速率、状态、长度和时间数据。
description.en: Test the original username set while preserving rate, status, length, and timing data.

description.zh: 把常见用户名逐条提交注册、登录或重置入口；响应差异（已存在提示、耗时、重置发送）即确认账号枚举。
description.en: Submit each common username to registration, login, or reset; response differences (exists hints, timing, reset dispatch) confirm account enumeration.

prerequisites.zh: 在 API 测试租户中创建存在、不存在和无权访问三类合成用户对象，并记录路由与对象级授权矩阵。
prerequisites.en: Create existing, nonexistent, and unauthorized synthetic user objects in an API test tenant, recording route and object-level authorization matrices.

prerequisites.zh: 以相同认证主体和请求 Header 随机测试候选路径，采集状态、schema、错误码、响应大小和后端对象查询。
prerequisites.en: Test candidate paths in randomized order with the same principal and headers, collecting status, schema, error codes, response size, and backend object lookups.

analysis.zh: 阳性枚举证据是存在对象与不存在对象具有稳定可区分的 API 响应；若返回对象内容，还需证明当前主体无对象级权限。仅发现路由、收到 401/403、公开资料按设计返回、统一 404、缓存结果或用户名出现在请求路径都不是未授权资源枚举。
analysis.en: Positive enumeration evidence is a stable distinguishable API response for existing versus nonexistent objects; if object content is returned, the current principal must also lack object-level authorization. Discovering a route, receiving 401 or 403, intentionally public profiles, uniform 404, cached results, or a username appearing in the request path is not unauthorized resource enumeration.

opsecTips.zh: 一个合成对象差异或一个无敏感字段的未授权对象返回后停止，不递增真实 ID 或批量扫描路由。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one synthetic-object differential or one unauthorized object without sensitive fields is returned; do not increment real IDs or scan routes in bulk.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试租户对象，清理 API 网关/应用缓存和请求日志，并恢复统一不存在响应与对象级授权。
opsecTips.en: Delete test-tenant objects, clear API gateway and application caches and request logs, and restore uniform not-found responses and object-level authorization.

name.zh: API 用户端点枚举

description.zh: 验证用户、账户和资料 API 是否因可预测路径或差异响应泄露账号存在性与资源结构。
description.en: Tests whether predictable user, account, and profile API paths or differential responses disclose account existence and resource structure.

subCategory.zh: API 与 RPC 攻击面发现

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 API 用户端点枚举场景，检验资源路径与差异响应对账号及接口结构信息的泄露程度。验证维度为用户与管理路径变体的逐条探测，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers API user-endpoint enumeration, testing how resource paths and differential responses disclose account and API-structure information. Validation probes user and admin path variants one by one, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于用户资源路径可预测且错误响应差异化：有效路径返回数据或结构化错误，无效路径返回通用 404，攻击者据此枚举账号与接口结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is predictable user-resource paths with differential error responses: valid paths return data or structured errors while invalid ones give generic 404s, letting attackers enumerate accounts and API structure.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本逐条请求用户与管理路径变体，记录状态码、响应结构与大小：任一路径返回有效用户数据或差异化错误即确认枚举面，同时对比认证前后的差异以界定泄露条件。成功判据以路径响应矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, request user and admin path variants one by one per the script, recording status codes, response shapes and sizes; any path returning valid user data or differential errors confirms the enumeration surface, contrasting pre- and post-authentication to bound disclosure conditions. Judge success by the path-response matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 用户资源改用不可枚举标识并统一错误响应结构，未授权访问一律返回通用 404。修复后重放第 1 步，全部路径应返回一致的匿名化响应。
mitigation.en: Switch user resources to non-enumerable identifiers with unified error shapes, returning generic 404 for all unauthorized access. After the fix, replay step 1: every path should return consistent anonymized responses.

description.zh: 从正常客户端记录存在、不存在与无权限用户资源响应。
description.en: Record existing, nonexistent, and unauthorized user-resource responses from a normal client.

description.zh: 按原始路径集合发起同身份请求并捕获 schema、状态与缓存信息。
description.en: Request the original path set with one identity and capture schema, status, and cache information.

description.zh: 用第二测试账号访问已发现资源，确认泄露是否伴随对象级越权。
description.en: Use a second test account against discovered resources to determine whether disclosure includes object-level authorization failure.

review.rationale: 内容是 API 路由与资源枚举，应从认证类别改归 API 安全。

description.zh: 版本号、复数与双斜杠变形命中未做枚举防护的路由别名。成功判据：变形路径返回用户存在性差异。
description.en: Version, plural, and double-slash mutations hit route aliases without enumeration protection. Success: mutated paths leak user existence.

description.zh: 数字主键遍历绕过用户名枚举防护的假设。成功判据：逐 ID 返回用户资料。
description.en: Numeric primary-key traversal bypasses username-oriented enumeration defenses. Success: profiles return per ID.

description.zh: JSON:API 媒体类型触发不同序列化器泄露字段。成功判据：返回包含存在性信号的响应体。
description.en: The JSON:API media type triggers a different serializer that leaks fields. Success: the response body contains existence signals.

title.en: Validation step 1 for API User-Endpoint Enumeration

description.zh: 逐条请求用户端点变体；任一路径返回有效用户数据或差异化错误，即确认 API 用户枚举面。
description.en: Request each user-endpoint variant; any path returning valid user data or differentiated errors confirms the API user-enumeration surface.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用 GraphQL schema fixture，创建存在、不存在和当前主体无权查看的合成用户名/邮箱记录。
prerequisites.en: Use a dedicated GraphQL schema fixture with existing, nonexistent, and current-principal-forbidden synthetic username or email records.

prerequisites.zh: 固定 query、variables、认证主体和字段选择，只替换一个标识符，并采集 data、errors.path、extensions 与 resolver 审计。
prerequisites.en: Fix query, variables, principal, and field selection, changing only one identifier while collecting data, errors.path, extensions, and resolver auditing.

analysis.zh: 阳性是存在与不存在合成账户在 GraphQL data、错误路径/代码或解析时延上形成稳定差异，或无权限主体获得受保护字段，resolver 日志可确认。统一 HTTP 200、正常 null、schema introspection、错误文本由客户端校验产生、缓存或公开 id 字段均不自动构成枚举/字段越权。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a stable difference between existing and nonexistent synthetic accounts in GraphQL data, error path or code, or resolver timing, or a protected field returned to an unauthorized principal, confirmed by resolver logs. Uniform HTTP 200, normal null, schema introspection, client-generated validation text, caching, or a public id field does not automatically establish enumeration or field-level bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个合成账户差异或受保护 canary 字段首次返回后停止，不使用 aliases/batching 扩大枚举。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one synthetic-account differential or protected canary field is first returned; do not expand enumeration with aliases or batching.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 schema fixture 与合成记录，清除 persisted-query/响应缓存和 resolver 调试日志，并恢复字段授权与统一错误。
opsecTips.en: Delete schema fixtures and synthetic records, clear persisted-query and response caches and resolver debug logs, and restore field authorization and uniform errors.

name.zh: GraphQL 用户存在性枚举

description.zh: 通过 user 查询参数和差异响应验证 GraphQL schema 是否泄露用户名或邮箱存在性，以及查询是否受字段级授权保护。
description.en: Uses user-query arguments and differential responses to test whether a GraphQL schema discloses username or email existence and enforces field-level authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 GraphQL 用户存在性枚举场景，检验 user 查询对存在与不存在账号的响应差异及字段授权。验证维度为用户名与邮箱查询参数的差异化提交，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers GraphQL user-existence enumeration, testing response differences between existing and absent accounts on user queries and field authorization. Validation submits username and email query parameters differentially, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于解析器对未命中对象返回结构化错误或 null 差异：响应形状本身泄露账号存在性，且查询不受字段级授权约束时信息进一步外溢。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is resolvers returning structured errors or null differences for misses: response shape itself discloses account existence, and without field-level authorization the information leaks further.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本对已知存在与确定不存在的用户名和邮箱逐条发起 user 查询，记录返回结构与错误文案：两类响应可区分即确认枚举面，再以无权限身份查询敏感字段验证授权缺口。成功判据以响应差异矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, issue user queries for known-existing and certainly-absent usernames and emails one by one per the script, recording return shapes and error texts; distinguishable responses confirm the enumeration surface, then query sensitive fields as an unauthorized identity to verify authorization gaps. Judge success by the response-difference matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 未命中查询返回与空结果一致的统一结构并延迟到授权后才区分，用户标识改用不可枚举 ID。修复后重放第 1 步，两类查询的响应应不可区分。
mitigation.en: Return uniform shapes identical to empty results for misses, deferring distinctions until after authorization, and switch user identifiers to non-enumerable IDs. After the fix, replay step 1: both query classes should be indistinguishable.

description.zh: 记录存在与不存在账号的 data、errors、path 和 resolver 日志。
description.en: Record data, errors, paths, and resolver logs for existing and nonexistent accounts.

description.zh: 使用原始 GraphQL 查询逐项替换 username/email，保持查询形状不变。
description.en: Use the original GraphQL queries and replace username or email one at a time while preserving query shape.

description.zh: 对发现对象查询 email、role 等字段并核对服务端授权决策。
description.en: Query fields such as email and role on discovered objects and verify server authorization decisions.

review.rationale: 这是 GraphQL API 枚举与字段授权测试，应归 API 安全。

description.zh: 用户名移入变量绕过查询体中 username 字面特征。成功判据：返回目标用户 id。
description.en: Moving usernames into variables masks literal signatures in the query body. Success: the target user's id returns.

description.zh: 单请求别名批量枚举绕过每请求一次的枚举限速。成功判据：一批用户名存在性同时返回。
description.en: Aliased batching bypasses per-request enumeration rate limits. Success: existence for a batch of usernames returns at once.

description.zh: 对比存在/不存在用户的错误文本与时延差异确认枚举信号。成功判据：两类请求可稳定区分。
description.en: Comparing error text and timing between existing and missing users confirms the enumeration signal. Success: the two classes are stably distinguishable.

title.en: Validation step 1 for GraphQL User-Existence Enumeration

description.zh: 逐条提交用户存在性查询；存在与不存在用户的响应结构差异即确认 GraphQL 用户枚举。
description.en: Submit each existence query; response-shape differences between existing and missing users confirm GraphQL user enumeration.

prerequisites.zh: 定位一个用户输入会进入响应 Header 的测试端点，并在隔离浏览器与代理中记录原始响应字节、解码次数和 Header 列表。
prerequisites.en: Locate a test endpoint where user input reaches a response header, and record raw response bytes, decode count, and header list in an isolated browser and proxy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用唯一无权限 Cookie 名和值，准备未编码、单编码、双编码和无 CRLF 的对照，确保没有真实会话同名。
prerequisites.en: Use a unique nonprivileged cookie name and value, with unencoded, single-encoded, double-encoded, and no-CRLF controls, ensuring no real session shares the name.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求编码 CRLF 被响应链解码为新的独立 Set-Cookie Header，真实浏览器存储了唯一 canary Cookie，原始字节和代理日志可证明分割位置。payload 出现在请求、应用日志或响应体，Header 值保留 `%0d%0a`，浏览器拒绝 Cookie，或服务端自行设置同名 Cookie都不是响应头注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires encoded CRLF to become a separate Set-Cookie response header, with a real browser storing the unique canary cookie and raw bytes plus proxy logs proving the split. A payload in the request, application log, or response body, a header retaining %0d%0a, browser rejection, or the server independently setting the same cookie is not response-header injection.

opsecTips.zh: 唯一 canary Cookie 首次被浏览器存储后停止，不注入真实 session ID、额外 Header 或响应体。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the unique canary cookie is stored once by the browser; do not inject a real session ID, extra headers, or response body.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 canary Cookie 和测试输入，清除浏览器/代理缓存与原始捕获，并恢复 Header 编码和 CRLF 拒绝。
opsecTips.en: Delete the canary cookie and test input, clear browser and proxy caches and raw captures, and restore header encoding and CRLF rejection.

name.zh: 认证会话 Set-Cookie CRLF 注入

description.zh: 验证用户输入未经服务端过滤编码即进入 HTTP 响应头时，能否注入新的 Set-Cookie，从而造成会话固定或响应拆分。
description.en: Tests whether unencoded input reaches HTTP response headers and injects a new Set-Cookie header, enabling session fixation or response splitting.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖认证会话 Set-Cookie 注入场景，检验未编码输入进入响应头后的会话固定与拆分影响。验证维度为多类会话 Cookie 名的 CRLF 注入变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Set-Cookie injection on authentication sessions, testing session-fixation and splitting impacts when unencoded input reaches response headers. Validation is a CRLF injection variant matrix over multiple session cookie names, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录或会话接口把用户输入写入 Set-Cookie 值而未过滤换行：攻击者注入攻击者会话 ID 或追加任意头，固定受害者会话或拆分响应。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is login or session interfaces writing user input into Set-Cookie values without newline filtering: attackers inject their session IDs or append arbitrary headers, fixing victim sessions or splitting responses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把 Set-Cookie 注入变体逐条置于可回显的头值或路径参数提交，检查响应头是否出现攻击者可控的会话 Cookie：命中后在浏览器验证 Cookie 被实际设置，再以固定会话访问受保护端点验证完整影响。成功判据以浏览器 Cookie 状态为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit Set-Cookie injection variants one by one in echoable header values or path parameters, checking responses for attacker-controlled session cookies; on a hit, verify in a browser that the cookie is actually set, then access protected endpoints with the fixed session to prove full impact. Judge success by browser cookie state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 会话值进入响应头前做严格字符校验并拒绝换行，框架层启用头注入防护；登录后轮换会话 ID。修复后重放第 1 步，全部变体应被过滤且无异常 Cookie 生成。
mitigation.en: Strictly validate characters before session values enter headers and reject newlines, enabling framework header-injection protections; rotate session IDs after login. After the fix, replay step 1: every variant should be filtered with no anomalous cookies set.

description.zh: 确认普通输入进入哪个响应头及经过哪些代理解码。
description.en: Confirm which response header receives normal input and which proxies decode it.

review.rationale: 根因是 HTTP 响应头注入，分类应从认证移到 API 安全；会话固定是后续影响。

title.zh: 双重/三重 URL 编码

description.zh: 绕过单次解码后匹配 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 的 WAF：应用二次解码时双重编码逐层还原；成功判据：响应头多出攻击者可控的 sessionid/JSESSIONID Cookie（响应中出现两个 Set-Cookie 行）。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching %0d%0aSet-Cookie after a single decode: double encoding peels back when the application decodes twice; success criterion: an attacker-controlled sessionid/JSESSIONID cookie appears as an extra Set-Cookie line in the response.

title.zh: 头名大小写与 OWS 变形

description.zh: 绕过对 "%0d%0aSet-Cookie: "（含空格）精确模板的规则：全大写/小写头名、去空格、冒号前空格与制表符均被响应解析器归一为合法 Set-Cookie；成功判据：会话 Cookie 被注入覆盖（客户端拿到 attacker_session_id）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the exact "%0d%0aSet-Cookie: " template: all-caps/lowercase names, missing space, space-before-colon and tab are all normalized as a valid Set-Cookie by response parsers; success criterion: the injected cookie overrides the session (client holds attacker_session_id).

title.zh: 仅 LF/仅 CR 分隔注入

description.zh: 绕过只拦截成对 %0d%0a 的规则：不少容器（Node/Python 部分服务器）接受裸 LF 或裸 CR 作为头边界；成功判据：仅 LF 或仅 CR 变体仍在响应中注入 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses rules blocking only the paired %0d%0a: several stacks (Node/Python servers) accept bare LF or bare CR as header boundaries; success criterion: a bare-LF or bare-CR variant still injects the cookie into the response.

description.zh: 绕过对 "Set-Cookie: name=value" 明文结构的规则：把冒号、等号、下划线、分号与 Path 属性整体 percent-encode，应用解码后语义完整；成功判据：注入 Cookie 生效且作用域为根路径（Path=/）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the plaintext "Set-Cookie: name=value" structure: percent-encoding the colon, equals, underscores, semicolon and Path attribute keeps semantics intact after application decoding; success criterion: the injected cookie takes effect scoped to the root path (Path=/).

title.zh: 空字节前缀与 Unicode 变形

description.zh: 绕过在 NUL 处截断或仅匹配标准编码的输入校验：NUL 中缀被宽容容器丢弃、%u 宽转义与 %c0%8d 过长编码在旧解析器还原为 CRLF；成功判据：响应中仍出现注入的 Set-Cookie 行。
description.en: Bypasses input validation that truncates at NUL or matches only canonical encodings: lenient containers drop the null infix, while %u wide escapes and %c0%8d overlong sequences decode to CRLF on legacy parsers; success criterion: the injected Set-Cookie line still appears in the response.

description.zh: 绕过单次解码匹配 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 的 WAF 规则：二次解码漏洞下双重编码还原；成功判据：响应多出注入的管理 Cookie 行。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching %0d%0aSet-Cookie after one decode: double encoding restores under double-decode flaws; success criterion: an injected admin cookie line appears in the response.

title.zh: 头名大小写与空白变形

description.zh: 绕过对 "Set-Cookie:" 精确字面（首字母大写+冒号后无空格）的规则：全大写/全小写、冒号前空格、制表符分隔等形态解析等价；成功判据：任一形态在响应中生效注入。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the exact "Set-Cookie:" literal: all-caps/lowercase, space before the colon and tab separators parse equivalently; success criterion: any form successfully injects into the response.

description.zh: 绕过对 admin=true 与 Path/Domain 明文特征的规则：等号、分号与属性名全部 percent-encode，应用解码后仍是合法 Cookie；成功判据：注入 Cookie 生效且带预期 Path/Domain 作用域。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the plaintext admin=true and Path/Domain features: encoding equals signs, semicolons and attribute names still yields a legal cookie after app decoding; success criterion: the injected cookie takes effect with the intended Path/Domain scope.

title.zh: 空字节与 Unicode 变形

description.zh: 绕过 NUL 截断与规范编码匹配：NUL 中缀被丢弃、宽/过长编码在宽容层还原 CRLF；成功判据：响应中仍出现注入 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses NUL truncation and canonical-encoding matching: null infixes are dropped while wide/overlong encodings restore CRLF at lenient layers; success criterion: the injected cookie still appears in the response.

title.zh: Cookie 名编码与属性走私

description.zh: 绕过对完整 "Set-Cookie:admin=true" 串的规则：Cookie 名 percent-encode、全大写或附带标准属性扩展载荷，并在尾部续接第二跳注入（X-Frame-Options）；成功判据：注入 Cookie 生效或额外头出现。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the full "Set-Cookie:admin=true" string: percent-encoding the cookie name, all-caps values, appending standard attributes, or chaining a second header (X-Frame-Options) after it; success criterion: the injected cookie takes effect or the extra header appears.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Generic Response Set-Cookie CRLF Injection

description.zh: 把 CRLF 加 Set-Cookie 变体逐条注入；响应出现注入的会话或权限 Cookie，即确认 Cookie 响应注入。
description.en: Inject each CRLF Set-Cookie variant; injected session or privilege cookies appearing in the response confirm cookie response injection.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Authentication Session Set-Cookie CRLF Injection

%0d%0aSet-Cookie: JSESSIONID=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: PHPSESSID=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: ASP.NET_SessionId=attacker_session_id

%0d%0aSet-Cookie: _rails_session=attacker_session_id
%0d%0aSet-Cookie: rack.session=attacker_session_id

%0d%0aSet-Cookie: session=attacker_session_id

%0d%0aSet-Cookie: XSRF-TOKEN=attacker_csrf
