%0d%0aSet-Cookie: AWSALBCORS=attacker_alb

description.zh: 把 Set-Cookie 注入变体逐条置于头值或参数；响应出现攻击者可控的会话 Cookie，即确认响应分割注入。
description.en: Place each Set-Cookie injection variant into header values or parameters; an attacker-controlled session cookie appearing in the response confirms response-splitting injection.

prerequisites.zh: 使用攻击者与受害者两个隔离浏览器配置文件和一个合成账户，记录登录前后服务端 session 映射。
prerequisites.en: Use isolated attacker and victim browser profiles plus one synthetic account, recording server-side session mapping before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 预置唯一 session ID 后让受害者完成测试登录，同时保存拒绝客户端 ID 和登录时强制轮换的阴性对照。
prerequisites.en: Preset a unique session ID before the victim's test login, retaining negative controls that reject client IDs and rotate IDs at authentication.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求应用在登录后继续使用攻击者已知的同一 session ID，并且攻击者配置文件凭该 ID 能读取合成已认证 canary，服务端映射可确认。Cookie 被接收、登录前匿名会话存在、ID 仅部分相似、登录后已轮换、攻击者得到 401 或共享测试账户主动登录都不是会话固定。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the application to retain the exact attacker-known session ID after login and the attacker profile to read the synthetic authenticated canary with that ID, confirmed by server mapping. Cookie acceptance, a pre-login anonymous session, partially similar IDs, rotation after login, HTTP 401 for the attacker, or both parties intentionally logging into the shared test account is not session fixation.

opsecTips.zh: 攻击者配置文件首次通过固定 ID 读取无敏感 canary 后停止，不执行账户或会话设置变更。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the attacker profile first reads the nonsensitive canary through the fixed ID; do not change account or session settings.

opsecTips.zh: 注销两个配置文件，撤销并删除服务端 session，清除 Cookie/缓存和测试账户，再恢复登录/提权时轮换。
opsecTips.en: Sign out both profiles, revoke and delete server sessions, clear cookies, caches, and the test account, and restore rotation at login and privilege elevation.

name.zh: 预设 Session ID 会话固定

description.zh: 验证应用登录成功后是否继续使用攻击者预先知道的 Session ID，从而允许复用受害者已认证会话。
description.en: Tests whether an application continues using an attacker-known session ID after login, allowing reuse of the victim's authenticated session.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖预设会话标识的会话固定场景，检验主流框架会话 Cookie 在登录后是否沿用攻击者已知值。验证维度为多框架会话名的预设 ID 注入与登录后复用，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers session fixation via preset session identifiers, testing whether mainstream framework session cookies keep attacker-known values after login. Validation injects preset IDs across framework cookie names and reuses them post-login, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录成功后未轮换会话 ID 且接受请求中预设的会话值：攻击者先把已知 ID 种入受害者浏览器，登录完成后即可直接复用该已认证会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is session IDs not rotating after successful login while accepting preset values from requests: attackers first seed a known ID into the victim browser, then reuse the authenticated session outright after login.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把各框架会话 Cookie 名的预设值置入请求发起登录，登录成功后以同一 ID 访问受保护页面：会话有效且身份为目标用户即确认会话固定成立。成功判据以预设 ID 登录后的授权访问为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时记录登录前后 Cookie 变化作为轮换行为证据。
exploitation.en: In step 1, seed preset values for each framework's session cookie name into the request and initiate login per the script, then access a protected page with the same ID; a valid session under the target identity confirms fixation. Judge success by authorized access under the preset ID post-login. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; record cookie changes across login as rotation-behavior evidence.

mitigation.zh: 登录与权限变更时强制轮换会话 ID，拒绝请求携带的非服务端会话值并设置会话 Cookie 为 HttpOnly。修复后重放第 1 步，预设 ID 应在登录后被替换为全新值。
mitigation.en: Force session-ID rotation on login and privilege changes, refuse non-server session values from requests, and mark session cookies HttpOnly. After the fix, replay step 1: preset IDs should be replaced by brand-new values after login.

description.zh: 在未认证浏览器设置原始 Session ID 并记录服务端状态。
description.en: Set the original session ID in an unauthenticated browser and record server state.

description.zh: 登录测试账号并比较前后 Cookie 与服务端会话主键。
description.en: Log in with a test account and compare cookie and server-side session keys before and after.

attackChain.payload:
PHPSESSID=attacker_known_session
JSESSIONID=attacker_known_session
ASP.NET_SessionId=attacker_known_session
connect.sid=attacker_known_session
sid=attacker_known_session
session=attacker_known_session
_sess=attacker_known_session
_session_id=attacker_known_session
_sessionid=attacker_known_session
app_session=attacker_known_session
user_session=attacker_known_session
auth_session=attacker_known_session
token=attacker_known_token

description.zh: 仅使用旧 ID 请求无害受保护资源，确认是否继承已认证主体。
description.en: Use only the old ID on a harmless protected resource and check whether it inherits the authenticated principal.

review.rationale: 这是明确的会话固定验证载荷，保留在认证分类。

description.zh: 会话标识经查询参数固定，登录后未轮换即成立。成功判据：登录后 Cookie 值仍为预设值。
description.en: Seeding the session id via query string; success if not rotated after login. Success: the cookie value stays at the preset after login.

description.zh: 多框架 Cookie 并存，任一未轮换即固定成功。成功判据：任一框架登录后复用预设值。
description.en: Multiple framework cookies coexist; any one not rotated means fixation. Success: any framework reuses the preset value after login.

description.zh: 编码值在解码层还原，绕过固定检测特征。成功判据：解码后预设会话被接受。
description.en: Encoded values resolve at the decode layer, evading fixation-detection signatures. Success: the decoded preset session is accepted.

prerequisites.zh: 在测试租户为 URL 参数与安全 Cookie 配置不同的合成 session/token，并记录网关、应用和会话存储的来源优先级。
prerequisites.en: Configure different synthetic sessions or tokens in URL parameters and secure cookies for a test tenant, recording source precedence across gateway, application, and session store.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离浏览器采集历史、代理日志和后续 Referer，并准备无 URL token、无 Cookie 与两者冲突的配对请求。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated browser to capture history, proxy logs, and subsequent Referer, with paired requests for no URL token, no cookie, and conflicting sources.

analysis.zh: 阳性可以是 URL 中攻击者预置 ID 覆盖安全 Cookie 并加载另一合成主体，或有效凭据实际进入浏览器历史、代理日志/Referer且仍可用于固定资源。参数被接受但忽略、URL 只含 `attacker_session` 占位符、页面回显、日志脱敏或 token 无效均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is either an attacker-preset URL ID overriding the secure cookie and loading another synthetic principal, or a valid credential actually entering browser history, proxy logs, or Referer and remaining usable on the fixed resource. An accepted but ignored parameter, a literal attacker_session placeholder, page reflection, redacted logs, or an invalid token is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个来源覆盖或单个泄露接收点被确认后停止，不沿重定向链传播凭据或访问更多端点。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one source override or one leakage recipient; do not propagate the credential through redirects or access more endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销合成 token/session，清除浏览器历史、Referer、代理/应用日志与缓存，并恢复只从安全 Header/Cookie 取凭据。
opsecTips.en: Revoke synthetic tokens and sessions, clear browser history, Referer data, proxy and application logs and caches, and restore credential intake only from secure headers or cookies.

name.zh: URL 参数会话标识注入
name.en: Session Identifier Injection via URL Parameters

description.zh: 验证应用是否从查询参数读取会话或认证 token，并优先于安全 Cookie 使用，造成会话固定与凭据泄露。
description.en: Tests whether an application reads session or authentication tokens from query parameters and prioritizes them over secure cookies, causing fixation and credential leakage.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 URL 参数会话标识场景，检验应用是否从查询串读取会话或令牌并优先于安全 Cookie。验证维度为多类会话参数名的 URL 注入对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers session identifiers in URL parameters, testing whether the app reads sessions or tokens from query strings ahead of secure cookies. Validation injects multiple session parameter names via URL, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于应用为兼容旧客户端保留 URL 会话参数且优先级高于 Cookie：会话值经浏览器历史、代理与 Referer 外泄，预设参数即完成会话固定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is apps keeping URL session parameters for legacy compatibility at higher priority than cookies: session values leak via history, proxies and Referer, and preset parameters achieve fixation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把各类会话参数名与预设值附加到目标 URL 请求，记录服务端采用的会话来源与主体：URL 值被采纳即确认会话暴露面，再检查访问日志与 Referer 确认外泄路径。成功判据以服务端会话决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, append session parameter names with preset values to target URLs per the script, recording which session source and principal the server adopts; adoption of the URL value confirms the exposure surface, then check access logs and Referer for leak paths. Judge success by the server's session decision. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 移除 URL 会话参数支持并强制 Cookie 承载会话，日志与监控对含会话样式的 URL 告警脱敏。修复后重放第 1 步，URL 参数应被忽略且历史链接无法复用会话。
mitigation.en: Remove URL session-parameter support and enforce cookie-based sessions, masking and alerting on session-shaped URLs in logs. After the fix, replay step 1: URL parameters should be ignored and historical links unable to reuse sessions.

description.zh: 分别测试 Cookie、URL 和冲突值，记录最终服务端主体。
description.en: Test cookie, URL, and conflicting values separately and record the final server principal.

title.zh: 提交 URL 标识集合

description.zh: 使用原始查询参数并配对不同 Cookie，观察解析优先级。
description.en: Use the original query parameters with a different cookie and observe parser precedence.

description.zh: 检查登录后轮换、日志和 Referer，确认是否控制身份或泄露。
description.en: Inspect post-login rotation, logs, and Referer to determine identity control or leakage.

review.rationale: 内容验证 URL 会话来源优先级和固定风险，可保留为认证 Payload。

description.zh: 大小写不同的参数名命中大小写不敏感的取参层。成功判据：会话从 URL 采信。
description.en: Differently-cased parameter names hit case-insensitive extraction layers. Success: the session is honored from the URL.

description.zh: 分号路径参数形态注入会话标识（Java/PHP 路径会话兼容）。成功判据：登录后使用注入会话。
description.en: Semicolon path parameters inject session ids (Java/PHP path-session compatibility). Success: login proceeds with the injected session.

description.zh: 多参数名并存命中实现实际读取的字段。成功判据：任一参数被采信为会话源。
description.en: Multiple parameter names coexist to hit whichever the implementation reads. Success: any parameter is honored as the session source.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Session Identifier Injection via URL Parameters

description.zh: 把会话参数逐条附加到 URL；服务端从 URL 接受会话标识，即确认 URL 传参的会话暴露面。
description.en: Append each session parameter to the URL; the server accepting the session identifier from the URL confirms the URL-based session exposure.

prerequisites.zh: 为 Cookie 与 Referer 查询参数配置不同的合成 session，并在网关、应用和认证中间件记录解析来源。
prerequisites.en: Configure different synthetic sessions in the cookie and Referer query parameter, recording parser sources in the gateway, application, and authentication middleware.

prerequisites.zh: 分别测试缺失 Referer、可信/不可信主机、冲突 token 和 Referrer-Policy 裁剪情况，其他认证字段保持不变。
prerequisites.en: Test missing Referer, trusted and untrusted hosts, conflicting tokens, and Referrer-Policy trimming separately while all other authentication fields remain fixed.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求后端从 Referer 查询中提取攻击者值并将最终主体切换到对应合成 session，认证日志明确记录该来源。Referer 可伪造、字符串被日志记录、风险分数改变、Cookie 仍决定主体、参数无效或页面仅重定向都不是 Referer 凭据解析漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the backend to extract the attacker value from the Referer query and switch the final principal to the corresponding synthetic session, explicitly recorded in authentication logs. Referer being forgeable, a string in logs, a changed risk score, the cookie still determining the principal, an invalid parameter, or a redirect alone is not a Referer credential-parsing flaw.

opsecTips.zh: Referer 首次改变合成主体后停止，不使用该 session 执行写操作或跨账户读取。
opsecTips.en: Stop after Referer first changes the synthetic principal; do not use that session for writes or cross-account reads.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销两套 session，清除 Referer/认证调试日志和浏览器数据，并移除 Referer token 解析与来源优先级。
opsecTips.en: Revoke both sessions, clear Referer and authentication debug logs and browser data, and remove Referer-token parsing and source precedence.

name.zh: Referer 中的会话标识注入

description.zh: 验证后端是否错误从 Referer 查询串提取 session/token 并将其作为认证状态，而不是仅把 Referer 用作辅助来源信号。
description.en: Tests whether a backend incorrectly extracts session or token values from a Referer query and treats them as authentication state rather than a secondary source signal.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Referer 中的会话标识解析场景，检验后端是否从来源头查询串提取凭据并作为认证状态。验证维度为携带会话参数的 Referer 变体注入，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers session identifiers parsed from Referer, testing whether backends extract credentials from source-header query strings as authentication state. Validation injects Referer variants carrying session parameters, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于后端兼容逻辑从 Referer 提取会话参数：该头可被任意站点控制，跨站页面构造含会话值的来源即可劫持或固定目标会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is backend compatibility logic extracting session parameters from Referer: the header is controllable by any site, so cross-site pages craft sources carrying session values to hijack or fix target sessions.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把携带各类会话参数的 Referer 变体注入受保护请求，记录服务端是否按 Referer 值建立或切换身份：来源头中的会话被采纳即确认解析缺陷，并以正常 Cookie 对照验证优先级。成功判据以服务端身份决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject Referer variants carrying session parameters into protected requests per the script, recording whether the server adopts the Referer value to establish or switch identity; a Referer-borne session being honored confirms the parsing flaw, contrasted with normal cookies for precedence. Judge success by the server's identity decision. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 删除从 Referer 提取凭据的兼容逻辑，会话仅从 Cookie 或 Authorization 读取并配置 Referrer-Policy 限制外泄。修复后重放第 1 步，Referer 会话值应被完全忽略。
mitigation.en: Remove credential-extraction compatibility from Referer handling, reading sessions only from Cookie or Authorization, and set Referrer-Policy to curb leaks. After the fix, replay step 1: Referer session values should be ignored entirely.

description.zh: 保存浏览器生成的 Referer、Cookie 与服务端主体。
description.en: Save browser-generated Referer, cookie, and server principal.

description.zh: 提交原始 Referer token 变体并同时提供不同 Cookie。
description.en: Submit the original Referer token variants while providing a different cookie.

description.zh: 确认真实浏览器能否产生并影响该值，排除只在原始 HTTP 客户端出现的结果。
description.en: Confirm whether a real browser can produce and influence the value, excluding raw-client-only behavior.

review.rationale: 属于错误的 Referer 凭据解析与来源优先级，保留在认证分类。

description.zh: Referer 携带多框架会话参数命中实现读取字段。成功判据：任一会话被采信。
description.en: Referer carrying multi-framework session parameters hits whatever the implementation reads. Success: any session is honored.

description.zh: 编码值在解析 Referer 时还原为会话来源。成功判据：编码会话被接受。
description.en: Encoded values resolve when parsing the Referer as a session source. Success: the encoded session is accepted.

description.zh: 重复头拼接/覆盖差异携带注入参数过审。成功判据：注入 Referer 被解析。
description.en: Duplicate-header concatenation/override smuggles the injected parameter past checks. Success: the injected Referer is parsed.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Session Identifier Injection through Referer

description.zh: 把携带会话参数的 Referer 逐条注入外发请求；服务端从 Referer 解析会话标识，即确认 Referer 会话泄露路径。
description.en: Inject each session-bearing Referer into outbound requests; the server parsing the session identifier from the Referer confirms the Referer session-leak path.

prerequisites.zh: 从隔离环境采集足量服务端实际签发的合成 session ID，记录编码、长度、时间、节点和登录轮换事件。
prerequisites.en: Collect enough server-issued synthetic session IDs in isolation, recording encoding, length, time, node, and login-rotation events.

prerequisites.zh: 将客户端预置的重复/顺序值与服务端生成样本分开，并准备在登录后验证 ID 是否映射到有效会话的受控请求。
prerequisites.en: Separate client-preset repeated or sequential values from server-generated samples, and prepare controlled requests to verify whether an ID maps to a valid session after login.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端接受低熵客户端 ID 并在认证后保持映射，或其自身生成序列可被独立预测且预测值成功访问固定合成会话。字符串外观看起来重复、Base64 可解码、少量样本有共同前缀、负载均衡节点位或猜测返回 401 都不是会话 ID 可预测性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the server to accept a low-entropy client ID and retain its authenticated mapping, or its own generated sequence to be independently predictable with a prediction successfully accessing a fixed synthetic session. Repetitive appearance, reversible Base64, a shared prefix in a few samples, load-balancer node bits, or a guess returning HTTP 401 is not session-ID predictability.

opsecTips.zh: 一次预测或预置值成功映射到合成会话后停止，不继续遍历相邻 ID 或其他用户。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one predicted or preset value maps to the synthetic session; do not iterate adjacent IDs or other users.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部采样会话，删除 ID 数据集和统计缓存，清除客户端 Cookie，并恢复 CSPRNG 与登录时轮换。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all sampled sessions, delete the ID dataset and statistical caches, clear client cookies, and restore CSPRNG generation and rotation at login.

name.zh: 低熵固定 Session ID 检测

description.zh: 使用重复、顺序和人类可预测值验证服务端是否接受低熵 Session ID，并检查登录后是否重新生成。
description.en: Uses repeated, sequential, and human-predictable values to test whether the server accepts low-entropy session IDs and regenerates them after login.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖低熵会话标识检测场景，检验服务端对重复与可预测会话值的接受度及登录轮换行为。验证维度为重复字符与顺序模式 ID 的逐条注入，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers low-entropy session-ID detection, testing server acceptance of repeated and predictable values and post-login rotation. Validation injects repeated-character and sequential-pattern IDs one by one, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于会话 ID 生成未使用 CSPRNG或接受了客户端提供的值：低熵 ID 可被猜测命中，登录不轮换则弱值可长期复用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is session IDs generated without a CSPRNG or accepted from clients: low-entropy IDs are guessable, and without login rotation weak values stay reusable indefinitely.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把全零、全 f 与顺序字符等低熵值置入会话 Cookie 请求受保护端点，记录服务端是否建立会话；命中后再验证登录流程是否生成新 ID。低熵值获得会话即确认熵缺陷。成功判据以会话建立与轮换记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, seed all-zero, all-f and sequential-character low-entropy values into session cookies against protected endpoints per the script, recording whether the server establishes sessions; on a hit, verify whether login generates fresh IDs. A low-entropy value gaining a session confirms the entropy defect. Judge success by session-establishment and rotation records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 会话 ID 改用 128 位以上 CSPRNG 输出并拒绝客户端提供值，登录与会权变更强制轮换。修复后重放第 1 步，低熵值应全部被拒绝且登录生成全新 ID。
mitigation.en: Generate session IDs from 128-bit-plus CSPRNG output, refuse client-supplied values, and force rotation on login and privilege changes. After the fix, replay step 1: low-entropy values should all be rejected and logins mint fresh IDs.

description.zh: 收集多次测试会话的长度、字符集、重复率和轮换行为。
description.en: Collect length, alphabet, collision rate, and rotation behavior across test sessions.

description.zh: 使用原始低熵字符串观察服务器是否接受、覆盖或拒绝。
description.en: Use the original low-entropy strings and observe whether the server accepts, replaces, or rejects them.

description.zh: 登录后从第二浏览器使用旧值，确认是否映射到已认证会话。
description.en: After login, use the old value from a second browser to see whether it maps to the authenticated session.

review.rationale: 修复乱码名称并明确低熵判断需要服务端生成或映射证据。

description.zh: 以时间戳派生前缀的样本检验熵来源是否可预测。成功判据：序列在多次采样间出现可推演规律。
description.en: Timestamp-derived samples test whether entropy sources are predictable. Success: sequences show derivable patterns across samples.

description.zh: 16 位截断形态检验会话 ID 有效熵长度。成功判据：生日碰撞空间可枚举。
description.en: 16-char truncated forms test the effective entropy length of session ids. Success: the birthday-collision space is enumerable.

description.zh: base64 包裹的低熵串检验规范化前是否解码比较。成功判据：解码后与裸样本判定一致。
description.en: base64-wrapped low-entropy strings test whether comparison happens after decode. Success: decoded forms judge identically to bare samples.

title.zh: 固定 Session ID 样例
title.en: Validation step 1 for Low-Entropy Fixed Session ID Detection

description.zh: 把低熵与重复模式会话 ID 逐条置于会话；服务端接受固定值会话，即确认会话 ID 熵不足。
description.en: Place each low-entropy or patterned session ID into the session; the server accepting fixed values confirms insufficient session-ID entropy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用短时效合成 bearer token 放入测试页面 URL，并控制同源、跨源与降级导航的所有接收端。
prerequisites.en: Place a short-lived synthetic bearer token in a test page URL and control every recipient for same-origin, cross-origin, and downgrade navigation.

prerequisites.zh: 固定浏览器和 Referrer-Policy，分别测试链接、资源加载和重定向，记录接收端原始 Referer 及 token 可用性。
prerequisites.en: Pin browser and Referrer-Policy, test links, resource loads, and redirects separately, and record the recipient's raw Referer and token usability.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求不受信任接收端实际记录到完整合成 token，且该 token 在有效期内能读取固定 canary，证明导航链造成可用凭据泄露。Referer 只含源站、查询已裁剪、请求发往自身域、日志已脱敏、占位符 token 或接收值无法认证都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an untrusted recipient to record the complete synthetic token and that token to read the fixed canary within its lifetime, proving usable credential leakage through navigation. A Referer containing only the origin, a stripped query, a request to the same trusted domain, redacted logs, a placeholder token, or a received value that cannot authenticate is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个受控接收端首次取得可用合成 token 后停止，不把它转发到第三方或访问其他资源。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one controlled recipient first obtains the usable synthetic token; do not forward it to a third party or access other resources.

opsecTips.zh: 立即撤销 token，删除接收日志和页面 URL，清除浏览器历史/缓存，并恢复严格 Referrer-Policy 与 URL 凭据禁用。
opsecTips.en: Immediately revoke the token, delete recipient logs and page URLs, clear browser history and caches, and restore a strict Referrer-Policy and prohibition on URL credentials.

name.zh: Referer Token 泄露验证

description.zh: 提交携带攻击者可控 Referer 的请求，验证服务端是否信任该头携带的令牌或会话上下文。
description.en: Submit requests with attacker-controlled Referer headers to verify whether the server trusts tokens or session context carried in that header.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Referer 令牌泄露场景，检验 URL 令牌在跨站导航与资源加载中是否随来源头外发。验证维度为外部域引用页与多类外发路径的泄露对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Referer token leakage, testing whether URL tokens ride out on the source header during cross-site navigation and resource loading. Validation contrasts external reference pages and multiple outbound paths, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌置于 URL 且未配置 Referrer-Policy：跳转或加载第三方资源时完整 URL 进入 Referer 发往不受信方，令牌随之泄露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is tokens in URLs without a Referrer-Policy: on jumps or third-party resource loads the full URL enters Referer toward untrusted parties, leaking the token.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在外部测试域部署引用收集页，把携带令牌的目标页通过跳转与子资源加载两类路径引向外部域，检查收集页收到的 Referer 是否包含令牌：出现完整令牌即确认泄露链成立。成功判据以收集页记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a reference-collection page on an external test domain, route the token-carrying target page toward it via jumps and subresource loads, and check whether collected Referers contain the token; a full token appearing completes the leak chain. Judge success by collection-page records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 令牌改由请求头或 Cookie 传递并配置 strict-origin-when-cross-origin 等策略，外链跳转经中转页剥离来源。修复后重放第 1 步，收集页应收不到含令牌的 Referer。
mitigation.en: Carry tokens via headers or cookies with strict-origin-when-cross-origin policies, and strip sources on outbound jumps through an interstitial. After the fix, replay step 1: the collection page should receive no token-bearing Referer.

description.zh: 把低权限一次性 token 放入隔离页面 URL，并记录有效期。
description.en: Place a low-privilege one-time token in an isolated page URL and record its lifetime.

description.zh: 访问原始外部目标并在接收服务器捕获 Referer。
description.en: Visit the original external targets and capture Referer at the receiving server.

description.zh: 协议切换组合降级重定向场景检验泄露面。成功判据：降级请求仍携带令牌。

description.en: Inject each external-domain Referer into token-bearing page navigation; the token appearing in Referers sent to the external domain confirms Referer token leakage.

prerequisites.zh: 为多个合成账户在隔离通知通道中签发足量 reset token，记录生成时间、请求上下文、消费和过期事件。
prerequisites.en: Issue enough reset tokens for multiple synthetic accounts through an isolated notification channel, recording generation time, request context, consumption, and expiry.

prerequisites.zh: 在不触发真实密码修改的 canary 端点分析长度、字符集、时间/计数相关性，并测试跨账户、重放和在线限速。
prerequisites.en: Analyze length, alphabet, and time or counter correlation at a canary endpoint that does not change a real password, and test cross-account binding, replay, and online rate limits.

analysis.zh: 阳性是独立生成的候选 token 显著优于随机基线地预测下一枚并成功进入对应合成账户的 reset canary，或 token 可跨账户/过期后/消费后重用。值较短、全数字、连续请求时间接近、一次偶然猜中测试 fixture、错误信息不同或无速率限制本身都不能证明可预测性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an independently generated candidate predicting the next token significantly better than random and reaching the corresponding synthetic account's reset canary, or a token remaining usable across accounts, after expiry, or after consumption. Short or numeric appearance, nearby request times, one coincidental fixture guess, different errors, or lack of rate limiting alone does not prove predictability.

opsecTips.zh: 一个预测、跨账户或重放 token 首次进入 canary 后停止，不提交密码变更或增加在线猜测量。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one predicted, cross-account, or replayed token first reaches the canary; do not submit a password change or increase online guesses.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部 reset token，清空隔离通知队列和样本数据，删除合成账户并恢复 CSPRNG、绑定、单次使用与限速。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all reset tokens, clear the isolated notification queue and sample data, delete synthetic accounts, and restore CSPRNG generation, binding, single use, and rate limits.

name.zh: 弱密码重置令牌猜测

description.zh: 验证密码重置 token 是否由 CSPRNG 生成、具备足够熵、短时有效、单次使用，并与目标账号和请求会话绑定。
description.en: Tests whether password-reset tokens are generated with a CSPRNG, have sufficient entropy, expire quickly, are single-use, and bind to the account and request context.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置令牌强度场景，检验令牌的熵、时效、单次使用及其与账号和请求会话的绑定关系。验证维度为短值与可预测令牌的逐条提交矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers password-reset token strength, testing token entropy, freshness, single use, and binding to the account and request session. Validation is a submission matrix of short and predictable tokens, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置令牌由弱随机源或短长度生成：可预测值落在搜索空间内即可冒领重置流程，缺乏单次与绑定约束时影响扩大到任意账号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is reset tokens from weak randomness or short lengths: predictable values fall within the searchable space to claim resets, and missing single-use and binding constraints widen impact to any account.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把短数字、顺序与常见词令牌逐条提交重置确认端点并配合 dry_run 类标记，记录接受情况：任一弱值进入流程即确认熵缺陷，再检查同一令牌重复提交的失效行为。成功判据以令牌接受矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit short-numeric, sequential and common-word tokens to the reset-confirm endpoint one by one with dry-run-style flags per the script, recording acceptances; any weak value entering the flow confirms the entropy defect, then check invalidation on resubmission of the same token. Judge success by the token-acceptance matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 重置令牌以 CSPRNG 生成 128 位以上熵、限时有效、单次使用并绑定账号与请求会话。修复后重放第 1 步，全部弱令牌应被拒绝且真实令牌用后即失效。
mitigation.en: Generate reset tokens with a CSPRNG at 128-bit-plus entropy, short-lived, single-use, bound to account and request session. After the fix, replay step 1: every weak token should be rejected and genuine tokens die on first use.

description.zh: 为多个专用账号记录 token 的长度、字符集、时间和唯一性。
description.en: Record length, alphabet, time, and uniqueness for tokens issued to dedicated accounts.

description.zh: 以低速使用原始短值候选，只针对可回滚的测试账号。
description.en: Use the original short candidates at a low rate against a reversible test account only.

prerequisites.zh: 签发短时效、最低权限的合成 JWT，并在测试 URL 中只暴露该 token，控制浏览器、代理、分析和第三方资源。
prerequisites.en: Issue a short-lived least-privilege synthetic JWT and expose only that token in a test URL, controlling browser, proxy, analytics, and third-party resources.

prerequisites.zh: 记录历史、访问日志、Referer 和分析事件中的完整/脱敏值，并准备 Header 传输基线与固定只读资源。
prerequisites.en: Record complete or redacted values in history, access logs, Referer, and analytics events, with a header-transport baseline and fixed read-only resource.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 JWT 的完整可用值到达非预期持久存储或受控第三方接收点，并可在过期前访问固定资源。查询参数里出现看似 JWT 的占位样本、日志只存哈希/前缀、token 已过期或签名无效、浏览器地址栏显示但没有额外接收方均不是可利用泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the complete usable JWT to reach an unintended persistent store or controlled third-party recipient and access the fixed resource before expiry. A JWT-like placeholder in a query, logs containing only a hash or prefix, an expired or invalidly signed token, or appearance only in the address bar without another recipient is not exploitable leakage.

opsecTips.zh: 一个非预期接收点首次获得可用 JWT 后停止，不跨服务重放或扩大日志搜索。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one unintended recipient first obtains the usable JWT; do not replay it across services or broaden log searches.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 JWT，删除 URL、日志、分析事件和浏览器数据中的副本，轮换 fixture key，并恢复 Authorization Header 传输。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the JWT, delete copies from URLs, logs, analytics events, and browser data, rotate the fixture key, and restore Authorization-header transport.

name.zh: JWT 在 URL 中泄露

description.zh: 验证放在查询参数中的 JWT 是否进入浏览历史、代理日志、分析系统或 Referer，并在泄露后仍可访问受保护资源。
description.en: Tests whether JWTs placed in query parameters reach browser history, proxy logs, analytics, or Referer and remain usable on protected resources after disclosure.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 传输泄露场景，检验查询参数承载的令牌进入日志、历史与 Referer 的路径。验证维度为多类令牌参数名的 URL 注入与外泄对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT transport leakage, testing paths by which query-string tokens reach logs, history and Referer. Validation injects multiple token parameter names via URL and contrasts leak paths, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于应用支持 URL 参数承载 JWT：令牌随完整 URL 被浏览器历史、代理日志与外发 Referer 记录，泄露后在其有效期内可被任意持有者重放。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is app support for URL-carried JWTs: tokens ride full URLs into browser history, proxy logs and outbound Referer, and once leaked remain replayable by any holder within validity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把测试 JWT 逐条置于不同参数名的 URL 中请求目标，随后检查代理日志、浏览器历史与外部 Referer 收集页是否捕获完整令牌：任一路径泄露即确认传输缺陷，并以泄露令牌重放验证有效期内的可用性。成功判据以泄露路径记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place test JWTs one by one under different URL parameter names against the target, then check proxy logs, browser history and an external Referer-collection page for captured tokens; any leak path confirms the transport defect, and replay the leaked token to prove in-validity reuse. Judge success by leak-path records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: JWT 仅经 Authorization 头或安全 Cookie 传输，URL 形式彻底下线；日志对令牌样式脱敏并缩短有效期。修复后重放第 1 步，全部路径应无令牌外泄。
mitigation.en: Transmit JWTs only via Authorization headers or secure cookies, retiring URL forms entirely; mask token shapes in logs and shorten validity. After the fix, replay step 1: no path should leak tokens.

description.zh: 创建短期可撤销令牌并记录 jti、audience 与有效期。
description.en: Create a short-lived revocable token and record jti, audience, and expiry.

description.zh: 使用原始查询参数访问端点并追踪浏览器、代理和应用日志。
description.en: Use the original query parameters and trace browser, proxy, and application logs.

description.zh: 从独立客户端使用捕获值访问无害资源，确认后立即撤销。
description.en: Use the captured value from an independent client on a harmless resource and revoke immediately after confirmation.

review.rationale: 修复乱码并从通用认证迁到 JWT 安全，强调真实泄露路径和 bearer 可用性。

title.zh: 传输变形：fragment 承载变体

description.zh: 传输变形：fragment 承载变体 — 令牌放 URL fragment（#后不进服务器日志），验证前端 JS 仍会读取解析的泄露面；成功判据：浏览器端 JS 拿到并使用了令牌。
description.en: Puts the token in the URL fragment (never server-logged) to verify client JS still parses it. Success: client-side JS picks up and uses the token.

title.zh: 传输变形：参数名轮换变体

description.zh: 传输变形：参数名轮换变体 — 轮换 access-token/session_state/auth 等参数名，绕过仅审计 access_token 参数的策略；成功判据：任一参数名被应用消费且进入日志/Referer。
description.en: Rotates parameter names to bypass policies auditing only access_token. Success: some name is consumed by the app and leaks into logs or Referer.

title.zh: 传输变形：Referer 泄露验证变体

description.zh: 传输变形：Referer 泄露验证变体 — 在带令牌 URL 的页面上，向会渲染到该页的内容字段注入指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 的资源引用，验证页面加载第三方资源时 Referer 是否外带完整令牌；成功判据：{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到含令牌的 Referer。
description.en: Triggers Referer exfiltration after the tokenized URL links out, verifying the third-party leak chain. Success: {ATTACKER_HOST} receives the Referer containing the token.

title.zh: JWT 在 URL 中泄露
title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT Leakage in URLs

description.zh: 把 JWT 逐条置于 URL 参数传输；令牌进入日志或 Referer 等路径，即确认 JWT 传输泄露。
description.en: Transport the JWT in each URL parameter; the token reaching logs, Referers, or similar paths confirms JWT transport leakage.

prerequisites.zh: 为 URL、Cookie 和 Authorization Header 配置互不相同的合成 token，并记录登录前后与提权时的 token 映射。
prerequisites.en: Configure distinct synthetic tokens in URL, cookie, and Authorization header sources, recording token mapping before and after login and privilege elevation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用攻击者与受害者隔离客户端，分别验证客户端预置值、来源冲突、登录轮换和刷新流程。
prerequisites.en: Use isolated attacker and victim clients to test client-preset values, source conflicts, login rotation, and refresh flows separately.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求攻击者预置 token 在受害者认证后仍保持同值并映射到已认证合成主体，或低信任 URL token 覆盖安全 Header/Cookie，攻击者可读取固定 canary。URL 出现 `attacker_token`、应用返回新 token、旧值失效、来源冲突被拒绝、或只有前端保存该字符串都不是 token 固定。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an attacker-preset token to retain the same value and map to the authenticated synthetic principal after victim login, or a low-trust URL token to override a secure header or cookie so the attacker reads the fixed canary. The literal attacker_token in a URL, issuance of a new token, invalidation of the old value, rejection of source conflict, or storage only in the client is not token fixation.

opsecTips.zh: 攻击者客户端首次通过固定 token 读取无敏感 canary 后停止，不刷新、委派或访问其他主体。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the attacker client first reads the nonsensitive canary with the fixed token; do not refresh, delegate, or access other principals.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有合成 token/session，清除 URL、Cookie、Header 和认证缓存，并恢复登录/提权轮换与唯一可信来源。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all synthetic tokens and sessions, clear URL, cookie, header, and authentication caches, and restore rotation at login or elevation and one trusted source.

name.zh: Token 固定与来源优先级测试

description.zh: 验证应用是否接受攻击者预设的 token 参数、在登录后沿用该值，或让 URL token 覆盖安全 Cookie/Authorization 凭据。
description.en: Tests whether an application accepts an attacker-preset token, retains it after login, or lets a URL token override secure cookie or Authorization credentials.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖令牌固定与来源优先级场景，检验 URL 令牌是否覆盖安全凭据来源并在登录后沿用。验证维度为多类令牌参数名的预设值注入与来源对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers token fixation and source precedence, testing whether URL tokens override secure credential sources and survive login. Validation injects preset values across token parameter names and contrasts sources, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌解析存在来源优先级且 URL 优先：攻击者预设的参数值压过 Cookie 与 Authorization 头，登录后服务端沿用该值即形成持久固定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is source precedence in token parsing favoring URLs: attacker-preset parameter values outweigh cookies and Authorization headers, and servers keeping the value after login create durable fixation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把预设令牌逐条置于不同参数名请求受保护端点，记录服务端采信的来源；再携预设值完成登录并复用同一值验证沿用行为。URL 值压过安全来源或登录后沿用即确认缺陷。成功判据以来源采信与沿用记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place preset tokens one by one under different parameter names against protected endpoints per the script, recording which source the server trusts; then complete login carrying the preset value and reuse it to verify persistence. URL values outranking secure sources or persisting post-login confirm the defect. Judge success by source-trust and persistence records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 令牌只从 Authorization 或 HttpOnly Cookie 读取并显式忽略查询参数，登录后强制轮换全部令牌。修复后重放第 1 步，URL 预设值应被忽略且登录产生新令牌。
mitigation.en: Read tokens only from Authorization or HttpOnly cookies, explicitly ignoring query parameters, and force full token rotation after login. After the fix, replay step 1: URL preset values should be ignored and logins mint new tokens.

description.zh: 在登录前通过原始参数设置已知值并记录匿名主体。
description.en: Set a known value through the original parameters before login and record the anonymous principal.

description.zh: 登录测试账号后比较 token 是否轮换以及服务端签发记录。
description.en: After test-account login, compare token rotation and server issuance records.

description.zh: 从第二客户端使用旧 token 并制造来源冲突，确认是否继承身份。
description.en: Use the old token from a second client and create a source conflict to test identity inheritance.

review.rationale: 属于 token 生命周期和来源优先级的会话固定测试，可保留为认证 Payload。

description.zh: 同时提交多个空值参数名，探测实现真正信任的令牌通道。成功判据：任一空值参数被服务端当作令牌来源解析（错误提示或行为差异可证）。
description.en: Empty values across many parameter names hit whichever channel the implementation trusts. Success: any empty channel enters authentication.

description.zh: Header 与 query 双通道同值注入，利用来源优先级差异验证令牌固定。成功判据：服务端采信注入值。
description.en: Fixing the token via both channels tests priority and enables injection. Success: the server honors the injected value.

description.zh: 编码参数名绕过黑名单键名匹配。成功判据：解码后被当作令牌来源。
description.en: Encoded parameter names bypass key-name blacklists. Success: decoded keys are treated as token sources.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Token Fixation and Source-Precedence Test

description.zh: 把攻击者预设 Token 逐条置于 URL 参数；服务端采信 URL 值并覆盖 Cookie/Authorization 等安全来源，或登录后仍沿用该预设值并映射到已认证主体，即确认 Token 固定与来源优先级缺陷。
description.en: Place each attacker-preset token into URL parameters; the server preferring the URL value over secure sources confirms token fixation and source-precedence flaws.

prerequisites.zh: 从隔离签发器采集跨多个时间窗口和合成主体的 token 样本，记录毫秒时间、节点、计数器与编码。
prerequisites.en: Collect token samples from an isolated issuer across multiple time windows and synthetic principals, recording millisecond time, node, counter, and encoding.

prerequisites.zh: 预先定义训练/留出集、随机基线和在线尝试上限，在固定 canary 上验证独立预测而非回放已观察值。
prerequisites.en: Predefine training and holdout sets, a random baseline, and an online-attempt cap, validating independent predictions against a fixed canary rather than replaying observed values.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求基于时间或计数模型生成的未见候选显著优于随机基线，并成功认证到对应合成 canary，且多批样本可复现。连续数字外观、token 与时间戳长度相同、相邻样本差 1、一次 fixture 命中、已签发 token 重放或返回不同错误都不是可预测性证明。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires unseen candidates generated by a time or counter model to outperform random baseline significantly and authenticate to the corresponding synthetic canary reproducibly across batches. Sequential appearance, timestamp-like length, adjacent samples differing by one, one fixture hit, replay of an issued token, or different errors is not proof of predictability.

opsecTips.zh: 一个留出 token 被独立预测并命中 canary 后停止，不扩大时间窗口或遍历真实 token 空间。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one holdout token is independently predicted and reaches the canary; do not widen the time window or enumerate the real token space.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销样本 token，删除时间序列数据和模型缓存，清理限速状态，并恢复 CSPRNG 与足够熵。
opsecTips.en: Revoke sampled tokens, delete time-series data and model caches, clear rate-limit state, and restore CSPRNG generation with sufficient entropy.

name.zh: 时间序列弱 Token 熵检测

description.zh: 使用相邻时间戳候选验证 token 是否由可预测时间或计数器生成，并通过统计样本确认而非单次猜测。
description.en: Uses adjacent timestamp candidates to test whether tokens derive predictably from time or counters and requires statistical confirmation rather than a single guess.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖时间序列令牌可预测性场景，检验令牌是否由时间戳或计数器直接派生并可被枚举。验证维度为相邻时间戳候选的批量提交与统计判定，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers time-series token predictability, testing whether tokens derive directly from timestamps or counters and can be enumerated. Validation batch-submits adjacent-timestamp candidates with statistical judgment, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌生成依赖毫秒级时间戳或可猜测的计数器：攻击者按业务时间窗口枚举相邻候选即可命中有效令牌，认证防线被整体绕过失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is token generation keyed to millisecond timestamps or guessable counters: attackers enumerate adjacent candidates around business-time windows to hit valid tokens, bypassing the authentication defense entirely.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把目标业务时间前后的毫秒时间戳候选批量提交令牌端点，统计命中情况：相邻值命中即确认时间派生缺陷，并以多组窗口重复验证排除巧合。成功判据以命中统计为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；候选生成速率控制在授权范围。
exploitation.en: In step 1, batch-submit millisecond-timestamp candidates around the target's business time to the token endpoint per the script and tally hits; adjacent-value hits confirm time-derived defects, repeating across multiple windows to rule out coincidence. Judge success by hit statistics. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; keep candidate generation rates within authorization.

mitigation.zh: 令牌改用 CSPRNG 生成并禁止时间或计数器直接参与，服务端对令牌枚举速率限制与告警。修复后重放第 1 步，候选命中应为零且批量请求触发限流。
mitigation.en: Generate tokens with a CSPRNG, barring direct timestamp or counter participation, and rate-limit plus alert on token enumeration. After the fix, replay step 1: candidate hits should be zero with batch requests throttled.

description.zh: 记录多账号 token 与精确签发时间，划分训练和验证样本。
description.en: Record tokens and exact issue times for several accounts and split training and validation samples.

description.zh: 使用原始连续时间戳集合验证是否存在稳定映射。
description.en: Use the original sequential timestamp set to test for a stable mapping.

description.zh: 只针对可撤销测试 token 重复验证预测，并记录限速行为。
description.en: Repeat prediction only against a revocable held-out test token and record rate-limit behavior.

review.rationale: 内容是 token 熵检测候选，保留在认证并补充统计验证标准。

description.zh: hex 形态触发弱类型比较窗口。成功判据：hex 与十进制判定不一致。
description.en: Hex forms trigger weak-comparison windows. Success: hex and decimal judge inconsistently.

description.zh: 大步长采样快速定位序号生成规律。成功判据：预测的中间值亦有效。
description.en: Large strides quickly locate the sequence generation pattern. Success: predicted intermediate values also work.

description.zh: hex 递增序列检验进制混用的可预测性。成功判据：hex 邻值连续有效。
description.en: Hex increments test predictability of mixed-radix generation. Success: adjacent hex values are consecutively valid.

description.zh: 大小写变形绕过黑名单精确匹配后序号仍有效。成功判据：任一变形值被采信。
description.en: Case mutations bypass exact-match blacklists while sequences stay valid. Success: any mutated value is honored.

description.zh: 把顺序 Token 与 Session 值逐条提交认证；任一可预测值通过验证，即确认会话标识可预测。
description.en: Submit each sequential token or session value to authentication; any predictable value passing confirms predictable session identifiers.

title.zh: 时间序列弱 Token 熵检测
title.en: Validation step 1 for Time-Sequential Weak Token Entropy Test

description.zh: 把时间序列候选 Token 逐条提交；相邻时间戳候选能通过认证，即确认令牌熵不足。
description.en: Submit each time-sequential token; predictable adjacent-timestamp tokens passing confirms insufficient token entropy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用只含合成用户和角色的测试签发器，记录 token 解码后的 schema、是否存在 MAC/签名以及服务端状态映射。
prerequisites.en: Use a test issuer containing only synthetic users and roles, recording the decoded token schema, presence of a MAC or signature, and server-side state mapping.

prerequisites.zh: 保留有效低权限 token 基线，只修改解码后的 username、role 或组合字段，再重新 Base64 编码并追踪授权结果。
prerequisites.en: Retain a valid low-privilege token baseline, modify only a decoded username, role, or combined field, then re-encode it with Base64 and trace authorization results.

analysis.zh: 阳性是没有完整性保护的修改内容被服务器信任，使合成主体或权限改变并访问固定 canary，认证日志显示直接采用了解码字段。能 Base64 解码、明文包含 admin/password、格式错误、token 被拒绝、前端显示修改值或服务端仍查表验证均不是 token 完整性漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is modified content without integrity protection being trusted by the server, changing the synthetic principal or privilege and reaching the fixed canary, with authentication logs showing direct use of decoded fields. Base64 decoding, plaintext containing admin or password, format errors, token rejection, client-side display changes, or server-side database verification is not a token-integrity flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 一个修改字段首次改变固定 canary 的主体/权限后停止，不组合用户名、密码和角色继续提权。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one modified field first changes the principal or privilege at the fixed canary; do not combine username, password, and role changes for further elevation.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销合成 token 和账户，清除解码/认证缓存与日志，并恢复带 MAC/签名的不可篡改 token 或服务端随机引用。
opsecTips.en: Revoke synthetic tokens and accounts, clear decoding and authentication caches and logs, and restore MAC- or signature-protected tokens or random server-side references.

name.zh: 可逆 Base64 Token 内容测试

description.zh: 验证应用是否把可逆 Base64 编码的用户名、密码或角色直接当作认证 token，而没有签名、MAC 或服务端状态验证。
description.en: Tests whether an application treats reversible Base64-encoded usernames, passwords, or roles as authentication tokens without a signature, MAC, or server-side state.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖可逆编码令牌场景，检验 Base64 形式令牌是否仅为编码而缺少签名与服务端状态校验。验证维度为常见身份值的编码令牌矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers reversibly-encoded tokens, testing whether Base64-style tokens are mere encodings lacking signatures and server-side state checks. Validation is a token matrix over common identity values, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌仅做 Base64 编码即承载身份且无密钥校验：攻击者自行编码任意用户名或角色即可通过认证，令牌与凭证完全脱钩。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is tokens carrying identity as bare Base64 with no keyed verification: attackers encode any username or role themselves and pass authentication, fully decoupling tokens from credentials.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把常见用户名、口令与组合值的 Base64 编码逐条提交认证端点，记录放行结果：任一编码值获得会话即确认仅编码缺陷，解码对照验证服务端未做任何签名核验。成功判据以放行矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit Base64 encodings of common usernames, passwords and combos to the authentication endpoint one by one per the script, recording allowances; any encoding gaining a session confirms the encoding-only defect, with decoded cross-checks proving no signature verification. Judge success by the allowance matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 令牌改为带签名的结构（如 HMAC 或 JWT 严格校验）并由服务端保存会话状态，拒绝无法验签的值。修复后重放第 1 步，全部自造编码应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Move tokens to signed structures such as HMAC or strictly validated JWTs with server-side session state, rejecting anything unverifiable. After the fix, replay step 1: every self-made encoding should be rejected.

description.zh: 对低权限测试 token 解码并记录字段边界，不使用真实凭据。
description.en: Decode a low-privilege test token and record field boundaries without using real credentials.

description.zh: 使用原始 Base64 候选替换一个无害字段后重新编码。
description.en: Use the original Base64 candidates to replace one harmless field and re-encode.

attackChain.payload:
token=YWRtaW4=
token=cm9vdA==
token=dGVzdA==
token=dXNlcg==
token=Z3Vlc3Q=
token=cGFzc3dvcmQ=
token=MTIzNDU2
token=MDAwMDAw
token=YWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=

description.zh: 检查服务端是否拒绝篡改并避免把解析成功当认证成功。
description.en: Check that the server rejects tampering and does not equate parsing success with authentication success.

review.rationale: 属于 token 完整性与错误使用编码的认证测试，不是编码工具本身。

description.zh: URL 安全字母表（-/_) 变形绕过字符集校验。成功判据：变形令牌仍被解码采信。
description.en: URL-safe alphabet mutations bypass charset validation. Success: mutated tokens still decode and are honored.

description.zh: 去除 = 填充改变长度特征，宽松解码仍还原。成功判据：无 padding 值通过校验。
description.en: Stripping = padding changes length signatures while lenient decoders still resolve. Success: padding-less values validate.

description.zh: 二次 base64 在多层解码实现中还原。成功判据：双重编码值通过校验。
description.en: A second base64 layer resolves in multi-decode implementations. Success: the double-encoded value validates.

description.zh: 把可逆 Base64 令牌逐条解码并提交；服务端接受解码出的身份值，即确认令牌仅编码未加密。
description.en: Decode and submit each reversible Base64 token; the server accepting the decoded identity values confirms encoding without encryption.

prerequisites.zh: 部署受控攻击 Origin 和真实浏览器测试配置，使用合成登录 Cookie 访问只含唯一 canary 的敏感型响应。
prerequisites.en: Deploy a controlled attacker Origin and real-browser test profile, using a synthetic login cookie against a sensitive-shaped response containing only a unique canary.

prerequisites.zh: 对多个任意 Origin 与已登记 Origin 发送带/不带 credentials 的请求，采集 ACAO、ACAC、Vary 与预检缓存。
prerequisites.en: Send credentialed and uncredentialed requests from multiple arbitrary and registered Origins, collecting ACAO, ACAC, Vary, and preflight-cache state.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务器动态反射任意攻击 Origin，同时允许凭证，且该 Origin 的浏览器脚本实际读取合成 canary。仅 Header 中回显 Origin、ACAC 缺失、通配符与 credentials 被浏览器阻止、公开响应、预检成功但实际读取失败或 curl 可见正文都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the server to dynamically reflect an arbitrary attacker Origin, permit credentials, and allow browser script at that Origin to read the synthetic canary. Origin reflection in a header alone, missing ACAC, browser rejection of wildcard with credentials, public responses, successful preflight without actual readability, or curl-visible content is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 任意 Origin 首次读取一个 canary 后停止，不请求实际账户数据、Authorization Header 或写操作。
opsecTips.en: Stop after an arbitrary Origin first reads one canary; do not request actual account data, Authorization headers, or write operations.

opsecTips.zh: 注销合成会话，删除攻击源和浏览器 profile，清除 CORS 缓存/日志，并恢复精确白名单、ACAC 策略和 Vary。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the synthetic session, delete the attacker origin and browser profile, clear CORS caches and logs, and restore exact allowlisting, ACAC policy, and Vary.

name.zh: 任意 Origin 反射验证

description.zh: 验证服务端是否把请求 Origin 原样写入 Access-Control-Allow-Origin，并在带凭证响应上允许任意站点读取。
description.en: Tests whether the server reflects request Origin into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and permits arbitrary sites to read credentialed responses.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖任意 Origin 反射场景，检验服务端是否把请求来源原样回写进响应并连同凭据一起放行。验证维度为外部域协议与端口变体的反射对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers arbitrary origin reflection, testing whether the server echoes request origins verbatim into responses and allows credentials alongside. Validation contrasts external-domain protocol and port variants, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 CORS 处理把 Origin 头直接写回 ACAO 并允许凭据：任意网站可在受害者浏览器中读取其会话数据，等同关闭跨源边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is CORS handling writing the Origin header straight back into ACAO with credentials allowed: any website can read a victim's session data in their browser, effectively dissolving the cross-origin boundary.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把外部域的多协议多端口 Origin 逐条随凭据请求发送，记录响应 ACAO 与 ACAC 组合：任一外部源被反射且凭据放行即确认反射缺陷，再以浏览器页面实际读取响应完成端到端验证。成功判据以反射与读取记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send external-domain multi-protocol multi-port origins with credentialed requests one by one, recording ACAO and ACAC combinations; any external origin reflected with credentials allowed confirms the reflection defect, then read responses from a browser page for end-to-end proof. Judge success by reflection and read records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: ACAO 仅回写预注册白名单来源，其余请求一律省略 CORS 头；凭据接口叠加来源无关的 CSRF 防护。修复后重放第 1 步，全部外部源应无反射。
mitigation.en: Echo ACAO only for pre-registered allowlisted origins, omitting CORS headers otherwise; stack origin-agnostic CSRF protection on credentialed APIs. After the fix, replay step 1: no external origin should be reflected.

title.zh: 记录可信 CORS 基线

description.zh: 保存可信源的 ACAO、ACAC、Vary 与预检行为。
description.en: Save ACAO, ACAC, Vary, and preflight behavior for a trusted origin.

description.zh: 使用原始攻击者域名逐项测试并保持请求凭据不变。
description.en: Test the original attacker domains one at a time while preserving request credentials.

title.en: Read the response in a browser

description.zh: 从攻击者源脚本读取无害受保护字段，确认真实跨源暴露。
description.en: Read a harmless protected field from attacker-origin script to confirm real cross-origin exposure.

review.rationale: 修复乱码并改归 API/CORS；必须以浏览器可读带凭证响应作为证据。

description.zh: 大小写混合命中大小写不敏感的反射逻辑。成功判据：ACAO 反射任意 Origin。
description.en: Mixed case hits case-insensitive reflection logic. Success: ACAO reflects the arbitrary origin.

description.zh: 末尾点域名与裸域解析等价但字符串不同。成功判据：反射头携带点号域并被浏览器接受。
description.en: Trailing-dot domains resolve identically yet differ as strings. Success: the reflected dotted origin is accepted by browsers.

description.zh: @ 前后域名拼接欺骗 contains 型校验。成功判据：攻击者域被反射。
description.en: Domains around @ fool contains-style validation. Success: the attacker domain is reflected.

prerequisites.zh: 在真实浏览器中创建 sandboxed iframe、file 或其他受控不透明源，并验证请求确实携带 `Origin: null`。
prerequisites.en: Create a controlled opaque origin using a sandboxed iframe, file, or equivalent in a real browser, verifying that the request actually carries Origin: null.

prerequisites.zh: 使用合成凭证和无敏感 canary 响应，记录 Cookie 发送条件、ACAO/ACAC、sandbox flags 与浏览器可读结果。
prerequisites.en: Use synthetic credentials and a nonsensitive canary response, recording cookie-send conditions, ACAO and ACAC, sandbox flags, and browser-readable outcome.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可由攻击者构造的不透明源以 `Origin: null` 携带合成凭证，并在浏览器中读取受保护 canary。服务器接受字符串 null、端口后缀变体、返回 ACAO:null 但无凭证、sandbox 禁止请求、响应为公开内容或 curl 读取均不是可利用 null Origin 信任。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an attacker-constructible opaque origin to send synthetic credentials with Origin: null and read the protected canary in a browser. Server acceptance of the string null, port-suffixed variants, ACAO:null without credentials, a sandbox that blocks the request, public content, or curl access is not exploitable null-Origin trust.

opsecTips.zh: 不透明源首次读取 canary 后停止，不放宽 sandbox 或加载真实用户页面。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the opaque origin first reads the canary; do not relax the sandbox or load real-user pages.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁 iframe/file fixture 和浏览器 profile，注销会话、清除预检缓存，并从 CORS 白名单移除 null。
opsecTips.en: Destroy iframe or file fixtures and the browser profile, revoke the session, clear preflight caches, and remove null from the CORS allowlist.

name.zh: CORS null Origin 信任测试

description.zh: 验证服务端是否允许 Origin: null 读取带凭证敏感响应，并确认该 null 源能从 sandbox、file 或不透明源场景真实产生。
description.en: Tests whether the server lets Origin: null read credentialed sensitive responses and whether that null origin is reachable from sandboxed, file, or opaque-origin contexts.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CORS null Origin 信任场景，检验服务端对来源为 null 的凭据请求放行及其真实可构造性。验证维度为 null Origin 请求与 sandbox iframe 的配合验证，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CORS null-origin trust, testing whether the server allows credentialed requests with a null origin and whether such origins are realistically constructible. Validation pairs a null-origin request with a sandboxed iframe, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于白名单包含字面量 null 或把无 Origin 请求视为可信：sandbox、data URI 等场景天然产生 null 来源，攻击者据此框架化页面读取凭据响应。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is allowlists containing the literal null or treating Origin-less requests as trusted: sandbox and data-URI contexts naturally produce null origins, letting attackers frame pages and read credentialed responses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步先以手工 Origin null 头请求账号接口记录响应头，再按脚本在 sandbox iframe 中以真实 null 源发起同一请求并尝试读取：响应反射 null 且浏览器可读即确认信任缺陷。成功判据以反射头与读取结果为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, first request the account API with a manual Origin null header recording response headers, then per the script fire the same request from a sandboxed iframe as a genuine null origin and attempt a read; reflection of null plus browser readability confirms the trust defect. Judge success by reflected headers and read results. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 从白名单移除 null 与通配值，无 Origin 请求按非浏览器流量处理并要求凭据接口显式校验。修复后重放第 1 步，null 源请求应无 ACAO 反射且读取被阻断。
mitigation.en: Remove null and wildcard values from allowlists, treat Origin-less requests as non-browser traffic, and require explicit validation on credentialed APIs. After the fix, replay step 1: null-origin requests should carry no ACAO reflection and reads must be blocked.

description.en: Record browser CORS behavior for trusted and ordinary attacker origins.

description.en: Different sandbox flag combinations still produce Origin: null cross-origin requests. Success: the target receives the credentialed null-origin request.

description.en: Requests from data: URI documents serialize Origin as null. Success: the null-origin request arrives and is allowed by reflection.

description.zh: 经 data: 或 sandbox 页中转的重定向链使最终请求 Origin 为 null。成功判据：目标收到 Origin: null 的凭据请求。
description.en: A redirect chain relayed through data:/sandbox pages yields a null Origin on the final request. Success: the target receives the credentialed Origin: null request.

prerequisites.zh: 建立目标组织子域资产清单和信任分级，明确哪些子域可由用户内容、第三方 SaaS 或测试团队控制。
prerequisites.en: Build a target-organization subdomain inventory and trust classification, identifying user-content, third-party SaaS, and test-team-controlled subdomains.

prerequisites.zh: 仅从受控低信任子域与外部相似域运行真实浏览器请求，使用合成凭证和固定 canary 记录 CORS 结果。
prerequisites.en: Run real-browser requests only from controlled low-trust subdomains and external lookalikes, using synthetic credentials and a fixed canary to record CORS outcomes.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求攻击者实际可控的低信任子域被 allowlist 接受，并能在浏览器中凭合成会话读取受保护 canary；这证明信任边界与子域治理不一致。仅允许公司自管子域、DNS 名称存在、候选字符串被反射、未接管的悬空记录、外观相似域被拒绝或公开响应均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an attacker-controlled low-trust subdomain to be accepted by the allowlist and read the protected canary in a browser with a synthetic session, proving misalignment between trust boundary and subdomain governance. An allowed company-managed subdomain, an existing DNS name, reflected candidate text, an unclaimed dangling record, rejected lookalike domains, or public responses are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 一个受控低信任子域首次读取 canary 后停止，不接管非测试 DNS 或探测其他组织资产。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one controlled low-trust subdomain first reads the canary; do not claim non-test DNS or probe other organizational assets.

opsecTips.zh: 注销会话，删除测试子域内容和 DNS，清除浏览器/CORS 缓存，并把白名单收敛到精确高信任源。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the session, delete test-subdomain content and DNS, clear browser and CORS caches, and narrow the allowlist to exact high-trust origins.

name.zh: CORS 子域信任绕过

description.zh: 验证 CORS 白名单是否把所有子域或相似后缀一并信任，并结合子域控制权判断是否可跨源读取敏感响应。
description.en: Tests whether a CORS allowlist trusts every subdomain or lookalike suffix and combines that result with actual subdomain control to assess cross-origin data exposure.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CORS 子域信任边界场景，检验白名单对子域与近邻域的放行宽度。验证维度为可控子域、任意子域与相似域的 Origin 矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CORS subdomain trust boundaries, testing allowlist breadth across subdomains and neighbor domains. Validation is an Origin matrix of controllable, wildcard and lookalike subdomains, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于白名单按通配子域或后缀匹配放行：任一子域存在 XSS 或接管即获得读取主站凭据响应的能力，信任边界被横向放大扩散。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is allowlists admitting wildcard subdomains or suffix matches: any subdomain with XSS or takeover gains the ability to read main-site credentialed responses, amplifying trust laterally.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把可控子域、任意前缀子域与近邻拼接域逐条置于 Origin 发送，记录反射与凭据放行结果：任一未注册来源被放行即确认边界过宽，结合该子域的实际控制权评估影响。成功判据以放行矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place controllable subdomains, arbitrary-prefix subdomains and concatenated lookalikes into Origin one by one per the script, recording reflections and credential allowances; any unregistered origin passing confirms the overly broad boundary, with impact gauged by actual control of that subdomain. Judge success by the allowance matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 白名单枚举确切主机名并纳入子域资产清单一并维护，禁用通配匹配；对遗留子域做接管检测。修复后重放第 1 步，全部非枚举来源应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enumerate exact hostnames in allowlists maintained alongside subdomain asset inventories, disabling wildcard matching, and run takeover checks on legacy subdomains. After the fix, replay step 1: every non-enumerated origin should be rejected.

description.zh: 区分核心业务、用户内容、开发和第三方托管子域的控制权。
description.en: Separate control of core business, user-content, development, and third-party-hosted subdomains.

description.zh: 使用原始真实子域与相似后缀集合，记录服务器白名单决策。
description.en: Use the original real-subdomain and lookalike-suffix set and record allowlist decisions.

description.zh: 仅在已授权可控子域用浏览器验证带凭证敏感响应是否可读。
description.en: Use a browser only from an authorized controllable subdomain to verify credentialed sensitive-response readability.

review.rationale: 修正 `--ext` 模糊 ID 对应的真实主题，归入 API/CORS 子域信任边界。

description.zh: 多层子域命中 endsWith 型白名单匹配。成功判据：深层子域被反射允许。
description.en: Deep subdomains hit endsWith-style allowlist matching. Success: the deep subdomain is allowed and reflected.

description.zh: 连字符/直连前缀欺骗子串校验。成功判据：任一形态被接受反射。
description.en: Hyphen/direct prefixes fool substring validation. Success: any form is accepted and reflected.

description.zh: 大小写变形绕过小写归一化前的白名单比对。成功判据：变形子域被反射。
description.en: Case mutations bypass allowlist comparisons applied before lowercasing. Success: the mutated subdomain is reflected.

title.en: Validation step 1 for CORS Subdomain Trust-Boundary Test

description.zh: 把子域与近邻域变体逐条置于 Origin；过宽白名单放行任一变体，即确认子域信任边界过宽。
description.en: Place each subdomain and neighbor-domain variant into Origin; an overly broad allowlist allowing any variant confirms an over-wide subdomain trust boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 控制测试域中的目标字符串前缀、后缀和连字符变体，并确认其 DNS/TLS 与真实目标完全独立。
prerequisites.en: Control test domains containing target-name prefixes, suffixes, and hyphen variants, confirming their DNS and TLS are fully separate from the real target.

prerequisites.zh: 记录服务端原始 Origin、URL 解析后的 scheme/host/port、正则匹配结果和浏览器 ACAO/ACAC 可读性。
prerequisites.en: Record raw Origin, parsed scheme, host, and port, regex match result, and browser readability under ACAO and ACAC.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求一个 DNS 上属于攻击者的 lookalike Origin 因未锚定、点未转义或缺少标签边界而被接受，并在浏览器中读取合成 canary。字符串包含 target.com、服务器返回 200、正则单元测试匹配、Origin 被反射但无凭证或浏览器阻止响应都不是可利用 CORS 正则绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an attacker-owned DNS lookalike Origin to be accepted because of missing anchors, unescaped dots, or absent label boundaries and to read the synthetic canary in a browser. Containing target.com as text, HTTP 200, a regex unit-test match, Origin reflection without credentials, or browser-blocked responses is not an exploitable CORS regex bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 首个 lookalike 域读取 canary 后停止，不注册额外相似域或请求真实敏感端点。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first lookalike domain reads the canary; do not register additional lookalikes or request real sensitive endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，删除测试 DNS/证书和页面，清除 CORS 缓存，并恢复 URL 解析后精确主机比较。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the test session, delete test DNS, certificates, and pages, clear CORS caches, and restore exact host comparison after URL parsing.

name.zh: CORS 域名正则边界绕过

description.zh: 验证 Origin 白名单正则是否缺少锚点、点号转义或 DNS label 边界，从而接受 target.com.attacker.com、target-com.evil.com 等相似域。
description.en: Tests whether an Origin allowlist regex lacks anchors, escaped dots, or DNS-label boundaries and accepts lookalikes such as target.com.attacker.com or target-com.evil.com.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CORS 域名正则边界绕过场景，检验白名单正则的锚点、转义与边界缺陷。验证维度为目标域前缀拼接与连字符变体的 Origin 矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CORS domain-regex boundary bypass, testing allowlist regexes for anchor, escaping and boundary flaws. Validation is an Origin matrix of target-domain prefixes, concatenations and hyphen variants, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于域名校验正则缺少起止锚点或未转义点号：攻击者域以包含关系命中规则，target 形态的恶意域被当作合法来源放行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is domain-validation regexes missing anchors or escaping dots: attacker domains match by containment, letting target-shaped malicious domains pass as legitimate origins.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把目标域前缀拼接、连字符分隔与相似拼写域逐条置于 Origin 发送，记录校验放行结果：任一相似域被反射凭据响应即确认正则边界缺陷。成功判据以放行与反射记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；命中时以浏览器读取完成验证闭环。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place target-domain prefix concatenations, hyphen separations and lookalike spellings into Origin one by one per the script, recording validation outcomes; any lookalike domain reflected on credentialed responses confirms the regex boundary defect. Judge success by allowance and reflection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; on hits, close the loop with a browser read.

mitigation.zh: 域名校验放弃正则改为解析后 host 精确比对，确需正则时补全锚点并转义点号。修复后重放第 1 步，全部相似域应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Replace domain regexes with parsed-host exact comparison; where regexes are unavoidable, add anchors and escape dots. After the fix, replay step 1: every lookalike domain should be rejected.

description.zh: 保存合法 Origin 的解析组件和 CORS 响应。
description.en: Save parsed components and CORS response for a legitimate Origin.

description.zh: 使用原始相似域集合并比较服务器解析及 ACAO 决策。
description.en: Use the original lookalike set and compare server parsing and ACAO decisions.

description.zh: 从授权控制域的浏览器读取无害字段，确认错误信任具有影响。
description.en: Read a harmless field from a browser on an authorized controlled domain to confirm impact.

review.rationale: 属于 CORS hostname 正则校验缺陷，应归 API 安全。

description.zh: 提交目标域前缀、连字符与拼接正则绕过域；任一域通过 Origin 校验，即确认正则边界缺陷。
description.en: Submit the prefix, hyphenated, and concatenated regex-bypass domains; any domain passing Origin validation confirms the regex-boundary flaw.

title.en: Validation step 1 for CORS Hostname Regex Boundary Bypass

description.zh: 复测三条正则绕过域；放行结果与正样例一致即确认该绕过在边界同样成立。
description.en: Replay the three regex-bypass domains; the same allowance as the positive samples confirms the bypass holds at the boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 从受控攻击 Origin 使用真实浏览器发送请求，构造 Origin 与 Referer 一致、冲突、Referer 缺失和被策略裁剪的组合。
prerequisites.en: Send requests from a controlled attacker Origin in a real browser, constructing combinations where Origin and Referer agree, conflict, Referer is absent, or policy-trimmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用合成凭证和 canary 响应，记录浏览器实际发送的两个 Header、服务端选择信号及完整 CORS 响应头。
prerequisites.en: Use synthetic credentials and a canary response, recording both headers actually sent by the browser, the server's selected signal, and complete CORS response headers.

analysis.zh: 阳性是服务端忽略不可信 Origin，因伪造/可信 Referer 而返回允许攻击源读取的 CORS 头，浏览器最终读到受保护 canary。Referer 改变风控、请求到达但响应不可读、无 credentials、Origin 本身已允许、curl 可伪造两头或 Referrer-Policy 导致缺失都不是组合绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the server ignoring an untrusted Origin and returning CORS headers that let the attacker origin read the protected canary because of a forged or trusted Referer. A Referer-driven risk-score change, delivered but unreadable response, absent credentials, an Origin already allowed, curl forging both headers, or Referer absence due to policy is not a combined bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 Header 冲突组合首次让浏览器读取 canary 后停止，不增加跨站状态变更请求。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one conflicting-header combination first lets the browser read the canary; do not add cross-site state-changing requests.

opsecTips.zh: 注销会话，删除攻击页面和浏览器数据，清除预检/代理缓存，并恢复只依据 Origin 的精确 CORS 决策。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the session, delete attacker pages and browser data, clear preflight and proxy caches, and restore exact CORS decisions based only on Origin.

name.zh: CORS 与 Referer 校验组合测试
name.en: Combined CORS and Referer Validation Test

description.zh: 验证服务端是否错误地用 Referer 代替 Origin 决定 CORS，或两个来源信号不一致时进入放行分支。
description.en: Tests whether a server incorrectly uses Referer instead of Origin for CORS decisions or allows requests when the two source signals disagree.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CORS 与 Referer 来源信号组合场景，检验双信号不一致时的仲裁逻辑缺陷。验证维度为缺失 Origin 携带 Referer 与双头冲突的变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers combined CORS and Referer source signals, testing arbitration flaws when the two disagree. Validation is a variant matrix of missing Origin with Referer present and conflicting header pairs, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端用 Referer 兜底 Origin 或冲突时取宽松分支：跨源判定被次要信号绕过，攻击者构造 Origin 缺失加受信 Referer 的组合即可放行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is servers falling back to Referer when Origin is absent or taking lenient branches on conflict: cross-origin checks get bypassed via secondary signals, and Origin-less requests with trusted Referers pass.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本组合缺失 Origin 加受信 Referer、双头冲突与端口变体逐条发送凭据请求，记录 CORS 判定结果：任一组合被放行即确认仲裁缺陷，区分兜底与优先级两种根因。成功判据以判定矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send credentialed requests combining missing Origin with trusted Referer, conflicting header pairs and port variants one by one per the script, recording CORS verdicts; any combination passing confirms the arbitration defect, distinguishing fallback versus precedence root causes. Judge success by the verdict matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 跨源判定仅以 Origin 为准且缺失即拒绝，Referer 不参与 CORS 决策；冲突日志并入监控。修复后重放第 1 步，全部组合应返回无凭据放行。
mitigation.en: Base cross-origin decisions solely on Origin, rejecting absence, and keep Referer out of CORS decisions; pipe conflicts into monitoring. After the fix, replay step 1: every combination should come back without credential allowance.

description.zh: 记录合法页面产生的 Origin、Referer 与预检序列。
description.en: Record Origin, Referer, and preflight sequence from a legitimate page.

description.zh: 将原始 Referer 值与不同 Origin 组合，并确认浏览器可真实产生。
description.en: Pair the original Referer values with different Origins and confirm a real browser can produce the combination.

attackChain.payload:
Referer: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/path
Referer: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}:443/
Referer: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}:8080/

description.zh: 从不可信源脚本读取受保护字段并关联服务端校验分支。
description.en: Read a protected field from untrusted-origin script and correlate the server validation branch.

review.rationale: 内容测试 CORS/Referer 混用，应从认证迁到 API/CORS 并要求浏览器可达组合。

description.zh: Origin 为 null 而 Referer 为合法域的组合命中只校验单信号的逻辑。成功判据：凭据响应携带 ACAO: null。
description.en: A null Origin with a legit Referer hits single-signal validation. Success: the credentialed response carries ACAO: null.

description.zh: 编码 Referer 在二次解码后命中白名单。成功判据：组合通过来源校验。
description.en: The encoded Referer hits the allowlist after secondary decoding. Success: the pair passes origin validation.

description.zh: 显式 443 端口使字符串不同而语义相同。成功判据：组合被当作可信来源。
description.en: An explicit :443 differs as a string while staying semantically identical. Success: the pair is treated as a trusted origin.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Combined CORS and Referer Validation Test

execution.command:
Referer: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/path
Referer: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}:443/
Referer: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}:8080/

description.zh: 把 Referer 变体与 CORS 请求组合逐条发送；来源信号不一致时仍放行，即确认 CORS 与 Referer 校验组合缺陷。
description.en: Send each Referer variant combined with the CORS request; allowance despite inconsistent source signals confirms combined CORS and Referer validation flaws.

prerequisites.zh: 使用受控跨站页面和合成账户，选择只改变可回滚 canary 的 API，并记录 Cookie SameSite 与 CSRF 控制。
prerequisites.en: Use a controlled cross-site page and synthetic account, selecting an API that changes only a reversible canary and recording cookie SameSite and CSRF controls.

prerequisites.zh: 分别以三种 simple Content-Type 和需要预检的 JSON 发送语义相同请求，采集 OPTIONS、实际请求、认证和状态变化。
prerequisites.en: Send semantically identical requests with the three simple Content-Types and preflighted JSON separately, collecting OPTIONS, actual request, authentication, and state change.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须区分两类影响：simple request 未经预检仍携带凭证并改变 canary，或攻击源还能通过正确 CORS 头读取敏感型响应。没有 OPTIONS、POST 到达、返回 opaque response、浏览器不能读取、服务器因 CSRF token 拒绝、Cookie 未发送或仅解析失败都不是认证绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence must distinguish two impacts: a simple request carries credentials and changes the canary without preflight, or the attacker origin additionally reads a sensitive-shaped response through valid CORS headers. No OPTIONS, POST delivery, an opaque response, browser unreadability, CSRF-token rejection, absent cookies, or parse failure is not authentication bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 simple request 首次改变可逆 canary 或读取一次响应后停止，不测试转账、删除或权限变更。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one simple request first changes the reversible canary or reads one response; do not test transfers, deletion, or privilege changes.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚 canary，注销会话，删除跨站页面和浏览器 profile，清除预检缓存，并恢复 CSRF 与内容类型校验。
opsecTips.en: Roll back the canary, revoke the session, delete the cross-site page and browser profile, clear preflight caches, and restore CSRF and content-type validation.

name.zh: CORS 简单请求绕过预检

description.zh: 验证仅保护预检路径的 API 是否仍会接受 text/plain、表单等简单跨源请求，并区分请求发送与响应可读两种影响。
description.en: Tests whether APIs protected only at preflight still accept simple cross-origin requests using text/plain or form encodings and distinguishes request delivery from response readability.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CORS 简单请求与预检边界场景，检验仅防护预检路径的 API 对简单跨源写的暴露。验证维度为三类简单 Content-Type 的跨站写请求矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CORS simple-request versus preflight boundaries, testing APIs that guard only preflight paths against simple cross-origin writes. Validation is a cross-site write matrix over three simple Content-Types, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于防护模型把预检视为安全边界而忽略简单请求天然免检：表单与 text/plain 跨站写直达业务端点，预检缺失不构成任何阻断。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is protection models treating preflight as the security boundary while simple requests are naturally exempt: form and text/plain cross-site writes reach business endpoints with no preflight obstruction at all.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本以表单编码、multipart 与 text/plain 三种类型从跨站页面发送状态变更请求，记录服务端处理结果：无预检且写操作生效即确认边界缺陷，同时区分请求送达与响应可读两种影响。成功判据以写操作生效记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send state-changing requests from a cross-site page as form-encoded, multipart and text/plain per the script, recording server handling; writes landing without preflight confirm the boundary defect, distinguishing request delivery from response readability. Judge success by effective-write records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 跨源防护不依赖预检，业务端点校验 Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site 并叠加 CSRF Token；简单请求同样纳入限速。修复后重放第 1 步，三类请求应全部被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Never rely on preflight for cross-origin protection: business endpoints validate Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site with CSRF tokens stacked, and simple requests get rate-limited too. After the fix, replay step 1: all three request types should be rejected.

title.zh: 记录 JSON 预检基线

description.zh: 捕获正常 JSON 请求的 OPTIONS、实际请求和状态变化。
description.en: Capture OPTIONS, the actual request, and state change for normal JSON.

description.zh: 使用原始三类 Content-Type 重放语义相同的测试请求。
description.en: Replay the semantically equivalent test request with the original three content types.

attackChain.payload:
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Content-Type: text/plain

description.zh: 分别确认是否改变状态、是否携带凭据和攻击者脚本能否读取响应。
description.en: Verify state change, credential attachment, and attacker-script readability separately.

review.rationale: 这是 API 的 CORS 简单请求/预检边界测试，不是一般认证绕过。

description.zh: text/plain 属 CORS 简单请求免预检，直发携凭据写操作。成功判据：状态变更生效且无预检发生。
description.en: text/plain qualifies as a CORS simple request, sending the credentialed write without preflight. Success: the state changes with no preflight.

wafBypass.command: const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('action','delete'); fetch('http://{TARGET}/api/state-change', {method:'POST', body:fd, credentials:'include'})

description.zh: multipart/form-data 同属简单请求类型。成功判据：表单写操作成功执行。
description.en: multipart/form-data is likewise a simple request type. Success: the form write executes.

title.zh: 自定义头触发预检降级

wafBypass.command: curl -sS --max-time 5 -X OPTIONS -H "Origin: https://{ATTACKER_HOST}" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: X-Ping" http://{TARGET}/api/state-change

description.zh: 携带非标准头触发预检并探测预检响应是否过宽放行。成功判据：预检响应 ACAO 反射攻击者域。
description.en: A non-standard header forces a preflight that probes for overly permissive responses. Success: the preflight reflects the attacker origin in ACAO.

title.en: Validation step 1 for CORS Simple-Request and Preflight Boundary Test

execution.command:
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Content-Type: text/plain

description.zh: 以三种简单请求 Content-Type 逐条发送跨站写请求；无预检即被处理，即确认预检边界依赖内容类型可绕过。
description.en: Send cross-site writes with each simple-request Content-Type; processing without preflight confirms a preflight boundary bypassable via content type.
